This role is Onsite #Onsite

QA Laboratory Systems Analyst

Through its programs and services, LCBO Quality Assurance department supports the organization’s mission of ensuring that products offered to our Ontario customers and B2B clients are authentic, of high quality, safe to consume and compliant with regulations.

Do you want to use your outstanding business administration and laboratory systems analyst expertise to support product testing and safety functions, exploring new and innovative technologies, and make your mark?

Reporting to Senior Manager, Quality Assurance Laboratory, you will provide operational, technical and developmental support to Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) and apply your thorough knowledge of Business Analysis and Quality Assurance operations to assist with furthering product Quality Assurance business processes, formulate scope and objectives for department applications’ system development, improvement, and maintenance. Supporting the entire business of Quality Assurance department, you will also prepare system documentation and detailed specifications from which application programs will be sourced or enhanced, and coordinate with IT, to plan, execute, communicate and assist with various system implementations. You will use your superior talent in Business Intelligence to evaluate effectiveness of departmental business processes to create dashboards, reports and make recommendations for continuous improvements. You will demonstrate leadership, collaborating with multiple team stakeholders to evaluate and enhance processes and deliver results for clients.

If you are an innovative thinker who likes to understand the end-to-end business and loves a challenge, then this is the role for you.

About the Role

- Configure, support, troubleshoot and maintain LIMS and department application systems, programs and procedures
- Assist in preparing and coordinating project plans for technology initiatives, including business case definition and writing
- Develop detailed systems test plans, participate in testing, including user acceptance testing; analyze test results to ensure the solution meets the business needs
- Map and document business processes. Define, analyze, review, document and communicate functional requirements specific to Quality Assurance needs required to support business process redesign and technology enhancements
- Develop, configure, maintain and upgrade departmental performance monitoring tools
- Provide specialized data analysis, develop reports that support Quality Assurance functions, make data-driven recommendations for process optimization
- Provide technical and analytical advice to the management team. Provide leadership to the systems users; mentor, coach, and transfer knowledge to assist staff to resolve program and procedural problems
- Prepare user manuals, technical documentation and user training for existing and new applications, procedures and processes

- Post-secondary education in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent business experience
- Experience in requirements definition, acquisition, testing, configuration and implementation of LIMS
- Relevant work experience in business analysis and process improvement and proven success using analytics, process mapping and analysis, business modelling and statistical analysis to drive change and grow the business
- Relevant technical knowledge and expertise in the configuration of computer software, operating systems, and applications acquired through formal education and progressively responsible experience in systems development. Working knowledge of programming languages/coding
- Demonstrated understanding of chemical laboratory operations
- Demonstrated understanding of Quality Assurance end-to-end Supply Chain operations
- Proficiency in the following applications and quality assurance operations:

- Laboratory instrumentation integration software
- Statistical process control applications (e.g. NorthWest Analytical and/or other)
- Compusense and/or other Sensory evaluation applications (e.g. Compusense and/or other)

- Experience in effectively using data mining software, such as Qlik Sense, Tableau or Microstrategy
- Extensive practical knowledge of Access, Visio, SharePoint, VBA, SQL server databases. Proficient with Microsoft Office products, including sophisticated knowledge of Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook
- Strong adaptable interpersonal skills and the ability to translate functional business to technical language. Ability to grasp key drivers and measures of success for the business and integrate the short-term and long-term business strategies into technology solutions and applications integrations
- Effective collaboration and negotiation skills, ability to work and lead laterally across multiple groups
- Effective communication, both verbally and in report generation (technical writing)
- Work independently and effectively under pressure to tight deadlines, be solution-driven and a change champion

title: Strategic Initiatives Analyst
description:
Please refer to the How to Apply for a Job (for External Candidates) job aid for instructions on how to apply.

If you are an active McGill employee (ie: currently in an active contract or position at McGill University), do not apply through this Career Site. Login to your McGill Workday account and apply to this posting using the Find Jobs report (type Find Jobs in the search bar).

Position Summary:
The Strategic Initiatives Analyst provides a high level of support on strategic dossiers in the portfolio of the Vice-President (Research and Innovation) [VPRI]. The role of the incumbent is primarily data analysis, reporting and support on strategic files. Reporting to the Associate Director, Research Systems and Planning, the Analyst is a member of the Research Systems and Planning team and collaborates closely with Associate Directors and Senior Advisors. Due to the complexity of the various portfolios that fall within the unit’s mandate, the incumbent must function with an exceptional level of accuracy, sound judgment and efficiency.

Primary Responsibilities:
The Analyst provides technical, analytic, and management support for activities related to research administration, strategic planning, and reporting, including data collection, analysis, and presentation. The Analyst will participate in all aspects of data collection and analysis related to research funding and impact metrics (e.g., bibliometrics, research grants and contracts, chairs, prizes and awards, and innovation-related metrics). The output is applied in a wide range of materials and presentations, often related to mission critical decisions related to research investments.

The Analyst will apply their analytical and problem-solving skills to initiatives and projects related to research and reporting to derive meaningful insights. In this role, the Analyst is mainly responsible for: 1) Data quality and governance; 2) Data Analysis to inform decision making and support key stakeholders and 3) Research data management and administration

The Analyst works with other units within the RI sector, and liaises with other sectors, for example Analysis, Planning and Budget (APB), Research Financial Management Services, staff in the offices of the Provost and Faculty Deans as well as with McGill’s affiliated research institutes. Track and analyze metrics, compile reports, and communicate progress.

Description of specific responsibilities:

1. Data quality and governance

- Collaborate with data owners, technical teams, and business units to investigate and resolve data quality issues, ensuring that all data is complete, accurate, and delivered in a timely manner.
- Develop and maintain comprehensive business glossaries and data dictionaries to support a shared understanding of key terms, definitions, and metrics across all units within the VPRI portfolio.
- Standardize data methodologies, definitions, and sources to ensure consistent reporting of strategic metrics across all units within the Research and Innovation sector.
- Contribute to the ongoing development and implementation of data governance frameworks, policies, and procedures, supporting the creation and maintenance of high-quality, trusted data assets.
- Promote best practices in data stewardship and quality assurance through staff training, documentation, and collaborative initiatives, ensuring institutional data integrity through continuous validation, reconciliation, and standardization of reporting practices.

2. Data Analysis to inform decision making and support key stakeholders

- Collect, integrate, and analyze data from a variety of internal and external agencies, such as McGill’s internal grants management system, the Tri-Agencies, Canada Research Chair Program, and the Canada Foundation for Innovation.
- Participate in all aspects of data collection and analysis related to research funding and impact metrics, e.g. bibliometrics, research grants and contracts, chairs, prizes and awards, and innovation-related metrics.
- Design, develop, and maintain dynamic PowerBI dashboards tailored to the evolving needs of senior leadership, faculty, and research units. Respond to data and ad hoc information request from the McGill research community including the VPRI, Faculty Associate Deans of Research, and research groups often requiring a needs assessment to interpret information requirements.
- Collect, analyze, and report competition statistics related to research funding programs, including application volumes, success rates, and comparative performance across units and institutions.
- Design and maintain surveys and manage resulting data sets. Assume other responsibilities or tasks related to the support of research data and other strategic initiatives for the University as assigned.
- Provide insights and recommendations based on data analysis to support strategic objectives.
- Undertake special projects and develop data sets to support analysis.
- Continuously identify opportunities to enhance data analysis methodologies, improve reporting frameworks, and strengthen engagement with internal and external stakeholders.
- Stay informed about developments and emerging trends in the Canadian higher education and research funding landscape.

3. Research data management and administration

- Support the annual validation of data required for the Research Support Fund (RSF) program, ensuring accuracy and completeness.
- Liaise with faculties and affiliated hospitals to collect, verify, reconcile, and maintain data supporting RSF reporting.
- Maintain and update institutional researcher and faculty affiliations within bibliometric platforms to support accurate analysis and reporting.
- Produce bibliometric analyses, reports, dashboards, and customized data extracts to support strategic planning, institutional benchmarking, performance assessment, and decision-making.
- Provide guidance and support to internal stakeholders on the interpretation and appropriate use of bibliometric indicators, methodologies, and research performance metrics.
- Develop and deliver training sessions, user documentation, and other support materials to support the effective use of bibliometric platforms and research analytics tools.
- Respond to requests from senior administration, faculties, and other stakeholders for bibliometric data, analyses, and research performance information.
- Identify and implement opportunities to improve data collection, reporting processes, analytics workflows, and research information management practices to enhance service delivery and operational efficiency.

Other Qualifying Skills and/or Abilities

- Bachelor’s degree in a field emphasizing analytical and quantitative skills (e.g., mathematics, statistics, computer science, psychology, accounting, or educational research); a graduate degree is preferred.
- Two to four years of experience in research administration within a Canadian university environment, with strong knowledge of the research ecosystem and funding landscape.
- Demonstrated expertise in data analysis and visualization, including advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (Pivot Tables, Power Query) and experience with Power BI or Tableau (including DAX or equivalent tools) to create dashboards and analytical reports.
- Experience managing and querying data from relational databases (e.g., Oracle) and working with Microsoft Office 365 tools such as SharePoint and Microsoft Lists.
- Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret both quantitative and qualitative data, synthesize insights, and communicate findings clearly through data storytelling, written reports, and presentations.
- Experience with qualitative data analysis methods and tools to complement quantitative research and reporting.
- Excellent critical thinking, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to adapt analytical approaches to meet diverse stakeholder needs.
- Comprehensive understanding of the research funding landscape in Canada and Quebec, including major federal and provincial programs.
- Bilingual in both written and spoken English and French.

- Excellent writer with ability to prepare reports and presentations targeted to multiple audiences. Service-oriented approach to people and a proven ability to solve problems. Self-motivated, with well-developed organizational skills, able to prioritize a wide range of responsibilities, able to manage multiple projects simultaneously, and work well under pressure.

- Must be able to meet tight deadlines and demonstrate a high level of professionalism in working with a team of people to achieve specific outcomes.

title: Senior Analyst, Energy Industry Data
description:
Job Description

NRECA is a unique national trade association providing advocacy, financial services and business support services to over 900 consumer owned electric cooperatives across the country. NRECA employees are united by our mission, inclusive culture, collaborative workplace and commitment to service excellence. As a “best place to work” employer, we operate with integrity, transparency and a spirit of innovation.

Summary of Position:

NRECA's Business and Technology Strategies (BTS) department provides actionable guidance regarding opportunities and challenges facing our industry to support co-op decision-making, solutions application, resiliency, and affordable and reliable electrical power. We engage directly with internal and external stakeholders and represent our members' needs in key industry forums to help ensure the continued success of America's electric cooperatives and to showcase their value to consumer-members, the U.S. economy, and the national grid. NRECA members rely on BTS for insights and recommendations on current and future trends affecting operations, technology planning, consumer expectations, and policy.

The BTS Innovation and Emerging Technology team is looking for a Senior Analyst, Energy Industry Data to analyze energy industry trends, develop forecasts, and create impactful analytical products that support decision-making across NRECA and its membership. Working independently and with subject matter experts, you'll turn complex data into actionable insights that make a difference. This position is eligible for NRECA’s hybrid schedule which allows flexibility to work from home up to 2 days per/week.

Key Responsibilities:

- Analyzes electric cooperative and broader energy industry data to identify economic, operational, policy, technology, power supply, rate, and other industry trends.
- Develops research questions and analytical approaches that address electric cooperative and broader energy industry issues.
- Applies statistical modeling, quantitative methods, and economic analysis to test hypotheses, evaluate trends, and develop forecasts related to energy supply, consumption, cooperative economics, and other industry conditions.
- Manages, queries, integrates, and transforms datasets from multiple sources and establishes practices that support data quality, integrity, consistency, and appropriate use across research projects.
- Develops and maintains interactive dashboards, data visualizations, reports, and other analytical products that make complex industry information accessible and useful to internal teams, members, and stakeholders.
- Interprets and communicates technical and economic findings through written reports, presentations, webinars, podcasts and other member and stakeholder outreach.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

- 5+ years of experience in economics, energy, or policy analysis related to energy supply and consumption, or related areas.
- Experience applying analytical methods to assess how industry trends and changes in wholesale electricity markets, renewable energy, distributed energy, and retail rates impact utilities and their members.
- Bachelor’s degree in economics, engineering, data science, statistics, energy or environmental policy, or a related field. Advanced degree preferred
- Knowledge of the electric power industry, including generation, transmission, distribution, demand, utility economics, market fundamentals, and factors affecting electric cooperatives.
- Knowledge of energy industry datasets and data sources, including U.S. Energy Information Administration data and similar industry resources.
- Ability to provide service excellence by building relationships, being resourceful, responsive and respectful.
- Ability to travel.

Preferred Qualifications:

- Experience with common AI tools (e.g., Microsoft CoPilot, Claude, ChatGPT), cloud data warehouse/platform technologies (e.g. Snowflake), automation tools and scripting (e.g., Python, R, Power Automate, or similar) and economic modeling tools (e.g., IMPLAN or similar) preferred.

Essential Physical Requirements:

- The worker is required to have close visual acuity to perform an activity such as: preparing and analyzing data and figures; transcribing; viewing a computer terminal and extensive reading.
- Exerting up to 20 pounds of force occasionally, and/or up to 10 pounds of force frequently, and/or a negligible amount of force constantly to move objects. If the use of arm and/or leg controls requires exertion of forces greater than that for sedentary work and the worker sits most of the time, the job is rated for light work.

title: Field Data Collection Specialist
description:
About Cartesian

Cartesian is building spatial intelligence for indoor environments to drive operational efficiency. We’re tackling one of the biggest challenges in the $35T global retail industry: in-store inventory visibility. Our platform delivers accurate indoor positioning and actionable product location insights, helping retailers streamline operations, optimize workflows, and reduce inefficiencies. By fusing wireless signals and mobile computer vision, we provide a uniquely scalable, infrastructure-free solution already deployed by international fashion brands.

Founded by an MIT engineering professor and alumni behind award-winning, patented core technologies, Cartesian spun out in 2023. Originally backed by a U.S. National Science Foundation SBIR Award, we’ve bootstrapped to a live product now deployed in multiple countries and are scaling aggressively.

About the Role

We are looking for a Field Data Collection Specialist to join Cartesian at a pivotal moment in our growth. This is a hands-on, impact-driven role focused on data collection, field operations, and R&D product testing. You will spend significant time in retail environments evaluating model performance, collecting and validating data, identifying issues, and helping ensure our technology performs reliably in real-world conditions.

Success in this role requires curiosity, attention to detail, and a strong sense of ownership. You should enjoy investigating problems, working directly with customers and in retail environments, and collaborating closely with technical team members to design and execute on critical data collection processes.

Location: In-person in Kendall Square, Cambridge, with regular travel to retail stores throughout the Boston area and occasional regional travel.
Salary: $65,000 - $80,000 annually

What You’ll Do

- Plan and run data collection protocols in real-world environments (e.g., retail stores, warehouses, …)

- Use and provide feedback on new data collection tooling for R&D and engineering teams

- Operate and maintain RFID and other collection devices, and troubleshoot hardware and app issues in the field

- Travel to customer sites to evaluate system performance under real-world conditions

- Collect, validate, and analyze datasets used to improve product accuracy and reliability

- Perform basic scripting, troubleshooting, and debugging to support testing activities

- Investigate bugs, edge cases, and unexpected behavior, providing detailed feedback to R&D and engineering teams

- Improve and document testing and data collection processes to increase quality, consistency, and efficiency

- Test new features, mobile applications, and workflows before deployment

- Help represent customer and field perspectives within the organization

Qualifications

- 1+ years of experience in a technical, operational, support, research, testing, or related role

- Strong attention to detail and ability to execute rigorous, repeatable testing processes

- Experience running scripts (e.g., in Python) and working with technical tools

- Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently in ambiguous environments

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills

- Professional, customer-facing demeanor

- Reliable, accountable, and highly organized

- Ability and willingness to travel regularly to retail locations

- Associate's or Bachelor's degree in a technical field or equivalent practical experience

Nice to Have

- Experience with product testing, field testing, QA, or beta testing

- Experience collecting, validating, or analyzing data

- Experience in retail, customer support, customer success, field operations, or deployment roles

- Familiarity with Python, SQL, or data analysis tools

- Experience supporting data pipelines, data quality monitoring, or operational tooling

- Spanish language proficiency

- Startup or early-stage company experience

Why Cartesian

- Work on hard, real-world problems with immediate and visible impact

- Join a small, highly technical team with significant ownership and autonomy

- Build systems that are deployed and used globally

- Collaborative, thoughtful, low-ego culture focused on learning and execution

- Opportunity to become a product expert and grow into roles across data operations, deployment, R&D, testing, and product

- In-person team culture in the heart of Kendall Square, Cambridge

If You’re Not Sure You’re a Perfect Fit

We know that no one checks every box—and we don’t expect you to. If this role sounds exciting to you, and you think you could contribute to Cartesian’s mission, we encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn’t perfectly match the description. We care deeply about people who are curious, thoughtful, and motivated to learn, and we believe strong teams are built from a diversity of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.

Interview Process

- Introductory conversation focused on motivation, background, and fit

- Technical exercise involving testing, analysis, and basic coding/problem-solving

- Follow-up technical discussion focused on reasoning, troubleshooting, and decision-making

- Final conversation with the hiring manager focused on ownership, communication, and culture fit

- References and offer

title: Research Data Expert
description:
Hudson River Trading (HRT) is seeking a Research Data Expert to join our Data team. Data is a cornerstone of HRT’s trading strategies, serving as the raw fuel that powers research, automated trading, and risk management.

In this role, you will own a specific area of expertise, working on sourcing junior data engineers, platform engineers, and alpha researchers to build and maintain trading strategies. You will also be responsible for providing fully featurized datasets to statistical modeling researchers.

HRT does not have information siloes. You will be collaborating directly with our researchers and will be responsible for driving the business forward through rigorous data analysis and delivery. You will also manage the full end-to-end pipeline from vendor downloads to trading-ready data. As an expert in one area, you will mentor junior data engineers, assisting and validating their work, and will partner with our sourcing team to identify optimal opportunities for data procurement. Furthermore, you will be responsible for ensuring high-quality service by implementing rigorous data checks and alerts.

Responsibilities

- Develop and maintain fully featurized datasets for statistical modeling research

- Serve as the subject matter expert for a designated data domain

- Provide technical support and guidance to researchers on vendor data and derived datasets

- Mentor and direct junior data engineers, including performing code and data output validation

- Partner with the sourcing team to identify and evaluate new data procurement opportunities

About Superluminal Medicines
Superluminal Medicines is a generative biology and chemistry company revolutionizing the speed and accuracy of how small molecule medicines are created. We are seeking a Senior Scientist, Pharmacology to provide scientific and technical leadership within our Pharmacology team. This role will design, conduct, and interpret preclinical in vivo and in vitro studies to support lead optimization and progression of pipeline assets toward investigational new drug (IND)-enabling studies. Responsibilities include applying knowledge of G protein-coupled receptor (GPCR) signaling pathways, conducting studies using rodent models to evaluate changes in body weight, body composition, and glycemic control, and documenting study results and recommendations to inform compound selection and development decisions.

- Direct and oversee CRO activities for study design, model development, and execution, ensuring high scientific quality and timely data delivery.

- Experience contributing pharmacology data and recommendations to development candidate nomination, coordinating external research partners, and supporting IND-enabling activities.

The Salesforce Reporting & Analytics Specialist is a member of Sales Operations responsible for developing, maintaining, and governing Salesforce reports, dashboards, and commercial analytics solutions. This role helps leaders and business teams turn Salesforce data into accurate, timely, and actionable insights that support pipeline management, forecasting, revenue visibility, opportunity tracking, quote performance, and executive decision-making.

The specialist will partner across Sales, Sales Operations, Finance, Product, Engineering, and other commercial teams to understand reporting needs, translate business questions into scalable analytics solutions, and ensure that Salesforce reporting reflects established business processes and definitions. The role will also strengthen reporting governance, reduce manual data requests, promote self-service analytics, and establish the data foundation needed for future automation, advanced analytics, and AI-enabled capabilities.

Key Responsibilities

Salesforce Reporting and Dashboard Development

- Design, build, validate, and maintain Salesforce reports and dashboards that support commercial, operational, forecasting, and executive reporting needs.

- Develop reporting solutions that provide visibility into pipeline, revenue, opportunity progression, quote performance, forecast performance, and other business-critical metrics.

- Establish scalable reporting structures that meet both immediate business requirements and longer-term analytical needs.

- Optimize dashboards and reporting processes to improve usability, performance, consistency, and stakeholder adoption.

- Build solutions that reduce manual reporting activity and expand access to self-service insights.

Forecasting and Pipeline Analytics

- Develop and maintain reporting that supports Salesforce-native forecasting processes, categories, methodologies, and review cadences.

- Provide clear visibility into pipeline health, opportunity progression, forecast changes, and performance trends.

- Support forecast accuracy by identifying reporting gaps, investigating variances, and validating the underlying Salesforce data.

- Partner with Sales Operations and business leaders to improve forecast transparency, accountability, and confidence.

- Support reporting structures used by sellers, commercial leaders, Finance, and executive stakeholders.

Data Quality, Reconciliation, and Reporting Integrity

- Monitor Salesforce reporting data for accuracy, completeness, consistency, and reliability.

- Perform field-level, record-level, financial, and reporting reconciliation when discrepancies are identified.

- Investigate reporting defects, dashboard inconsistencies, duplicate data, integration-related issues, and forecast gaps.

- Partner with business and technical teams to identify root causes and coordinate remediation.

- Help ensure consistent definitions and calculations across Salesforce reports, dashboards, Finance reporting, and executive metrics.

- Establish controls and monitoring practices that increase stakeholder trust in Salesforce as the system of record.

Reporting Governance and Intake Management

- Establish and maintain reporting standards, definitions, documentation, and best practices.

- Manage or support a structured intake process for new reports, dashboards, analytics enhancements, and data-related requests.

- Evaluate requests based on business impact, urgency, scalability, and alignment with Salesforce reporting strategy.

- Reduce redundant reports and encourage the use of standardized, governed analytics assets.

- Maintain an operational backlog of reporting gaps, data-quality issues, forecasting improvements, and workflow simplification opportunities.

- Provide data-informed recommendations to Salesforce governance and prioritization discussions.

Cross-Functional Business Partnership

- Consult with Sales Leadership, Account Teams, Finance, Sales Operations, Product, Engineering, and Executive Leadership to understand reporting and analytics requirements.

- Translate business questions and operational needs into clear reporting requirements and scalable Salesforce solutions.

- Serve as a bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams to ensure that reporting accurately reflects commercial processes.

- Communicate findings, reporting risks, data limitations, and recommended actions in clear business language.

- Support cross-functional validation and prioritization of reporting enhancements and platform improvements.

Salesforce Adoption and Enablement

- Develop reports and dashboards that help users understand, monitor, and manage their business within Salesforce.

- Support user adoption by making information accessible, understandable, and actionable.

- Create documentation, reporting guidance, FAQs, and self-service resources.

- Contribute to Salesforce Office Hours, training sessions, knowledge resources, and other enablement activities as needed.

- Identify recurring user questions, reporting pain points, and adoption blockers, then recommend improvements.

- Promote consistent reporting and data-management practices across commercial teams.

Automation, Advanced Analytics, and AI Readiness

- Identify opportunities to automate recurring reports, dashboard processes, reconciliations, and manual data requests.

- Support the development of scalable reporting architecture for advanced analytics and emerging AI use cases.

- Improve the structure, consistency, and governance of Salesforce data used by analytical and automated solutions.

- Partner with technical teams to assess the reporting and data implications of platform changes, integrations, and new capabilities.

- Help position Sales Operations for continued growth in self-service analytics, automation, and data-informed decision-making.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

The following qualifications are recommended based on the stated responsibilities of the role:

- Five+ years’ experience developing and maintaining reports, dashboards, or analytical solutions in Salesforce or a comparable CRM platform.

- Demonstrated ability to translate business needs into reporting requirements and actionable insights.

- Five+ years’ experience working with pipeline, forecasting, revenue, opportunity, quote, or commercial-performance data.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to investigate discrepancies and validate data.

- Understanding of data-quality, reporting-governance, and metric-definition practices.

- Ability to communicate technical or analytical findings to nontechnical business stakeholders.

- Five+ years’ experience partnering across business and technical teams.

- Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple reporting requests and priorities.

- Commitment to accurate, consistent, and well-documented analytical work.

Preferred Qualifications

These are recommended qualifications that support the future-state scope described in the attachment:

- Five+ years’ experience with Salesforce report and dashboard architecture.

- Five+ years’ experience with CRM analytics, business intelligence, data visualization, or commercial analytics.

- Three+ years’ experience with PowerBI architecture

- Understanding of sales forecasting, pipeline management, revenue reporting, or sales operations.

- Five+ years’ experience automating reports, dashboards, reconciliations, or recurring analytical processes.

- Familiarity with data flows between Salesforce and downstream reporting platforms.

- Experience supporting user acceptance testing, reporting validation, system implementation, or platform stabilization.

- Familiarity with advanced analytics, AI readiness, or governed data foundations.

- Five+ years’ experience creating reporting documentation, standards, or self-service training materials.

Core Competencies

- Analytical problem-solving: Investigates complex reporting and data issues and converts findings into practical solutions.

- Business acumen: Understands how Salesforce data supports pipeline, forecasting, revenue, quoting, and commercial decisions.

- Data stewardship: Maintains a strong commitment to accuracy, consistency, governance, and trusted reporting.

- Stakeholder consulting: Builds effective partnerships and translates varied business needs into scalable reporting solutions.

- Systems thinking: Understands the relationship between Salesforce processes, integrations, reporting, and downstream business impacts.

- Communication: Explains metrics, discrepancies, decisions, and recommendations clearly to technical and nontechnical audiences.

- Continuous improvement: Looks beyond one-time solutions to simplify, automate, standardize, and scale reporting capabilities.

- Ownership and accountability: Manages reporting needs through discovery, design, validation, delivery, documentation, and ongoing maintenance.

Measures of Success

Success in this role may be measured through:

- Accuracy, reliability, and consistency of Salesforce reports and dashboards.

- Improved visibility into pipeline, forecasts, revenue, opportunities, and quote performance.

- Reduction in reporting defects, inconsistencies, and recurring reconciliation issues.

- Reduction in manual reporting requests and reporting backlog.

- Faster delivery of business-critical reporting and insights.

- Increased stakeholder confidence in Salesforce metrics.

- Increased adoption of governed reports, dashboards, and self-service analytics.

- Improved reporting documentation, standards, and governance.

- Demonstrated automation of repeatable reporting activities.

- Readiness of Salesforce reporting data for advanced analytics and AI-supported use cases.

These measures reflect the outcomes identified in the source document, including improved forecast confidence, faster decision-making, reduced reporting bottlenecks, increased data integrity, greater reporting automation, and stronger foundations for future analytics.

description:

Through our crypto solutions for financial institutions, businesses, governments and developers, we are improving the global financial system and creating greater economic fairness and opportunity for more people, in more places around the world. We are growing, and so is the breadth and depth of our marketing programs, with AI at the core of how we scale. We are looking for a highly motivated, diligent, and data-driven Senior Marketing Analytics Manager to join our Marketing Operations team. Reporting into the Director, Marketing Operations and Demand Generation, this role will serve as the analytical backbone of our growth marketing engine — leading the measurement, visualization, and insights infrastructure that drives smarter investment decisions and executive-level confidence in our marketing performance.

In this role, you will own analytics and reporting across all growth marketing functions, from campaign performance to pipeline attribution. You'll partner closely with Growth Marketing, Finance, RevOps, and other cross-functional teams to ensure data is accurate, accessible, and actionable across the full funnel. You'll also be a practitioner and champion of AI-powered tools — using them to automate workflows, accelerate insight generation, and elevate the sophistication of our marketing measurement at scale.

You'll use data to continuously improve reporting efficiency, forecast accuracy, and budget allocation decisions, helping ensure our marketing analytics engine drives measurable impact on pipeline and revenue.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

- Own analytics and end-to-end measurement across all growth marketing functions, ensuring consistent and actionable reporting from spend to revenue.

- Lead the visualization and reporting infrastructure across growth marketing, translating complex data into clear, compelling dashboards and narratives for stakeholders at all levels.

- Lead pipeline attribution, ROI, CAC, LTV, and Ad spend distribution analyses to inform investment decisions, and partner with Growth Marketing, Finance, and RevOps on spend pacing and forecasting.

- Evolve attribution modeling and performance measurement frameworks, using AI and machine learning to improve accuracy and scalability.

- Apply AI-powered tools and predictive modeling to surface proactive insights, identify trends, and support faster, more confident decision-making across the marketing team.

- Empower experimentation programs with thorough data-driven insights, including A/B testing and lift analyses.

- Partner with the RevOps, Business Intelligence and Marketing Operations teams to use Salesforce, Tableau, MCI and other platforms, to build reporting that connect spend to pipeline and revenue.

- Identify opportunities to automate reporting and analytics workflows using AI to increase efficiency and reduce manual effort.

- Ensure data quality and integrity across CRM and marketing systems.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

- 5+ years of experience in marketing analytics, growth analytics, or a related field

- Deep expertise in growth marketing measurement methodologies across the funnel

- Hands-on experience with Salesforce CRM and marketing data pipelines

- Familiarity with AI and machine learning concepts as applied to marketing analytics, such as predictive modelling, anomaly detection, or automated insights

- Strong proficiency in data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Looker, or similar)

- Experience with attribution modeling, media mix modeling, and/or incrementality testing

- Proficiency in SQL; experience with Python or R is a plus

- Proven track record in leading forecasting and budget analysis in partnership with Finance and Revenue Operations

- Excellent communication skills with the ability to present complex data clearly to both technical and executive audiences

- Strong cross-functional collaboration skills — you're as comfortable in a strategy meeting as you are in a data model

In this role, you'll partner across Professional Services, Product, Data Services, Operations, and Technology teams to analyze implementation trends, develop scalable delivery methodologies, build data-driven insights, and create repeatable frameworks that improve efficiency, consistency, and customer outcomes. You'll play a key role in shaping the future of service delivery through operational excellence, analytics, AI-enabled innovation, and scalable implementation strategies.

What You'll Do

- Analyze customer, utilization, billing, project performance, configuration, and implementation data to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities for improvement.
- Develop customer segmentation models, implementation archetypes, and delivery taxonomies to improve implementation predictability and scalability.
- Evaluate drivers of implementation effort, complexity, duration, and outcomes to improve planning accuracy and delivery performance.

- Evaluate emerging technologies, intelligent workflows, and automation opportunities that support Professional Services transformation.

title: Senior Process Metallurgist
description:

Charter Casting is hiring a Senior Process Metallurgist!

Alternative Job Titles: Senior Manufacturing Metallurgist, Lead Process Metallurgist, Senior Metallurgical Engineer

Job Summary:

As a Senior Process Metallurgist, you will provide technical leadership with a strong focus on metallurgical and process engineering across the Melt, Laboratory, and Continuous Casting operations. You will apply materials science, metallurgy, and manufacturing-process expertise to improve safety, quality, productivity, and cost.

Partnering closely with Operations and cross-functional teams, you will troubleshoot complex technical issues, strengthen process controls and standards, optimize melting and casting practices, support new-product development, and implement sustainable process improvements. This role serves as a primary technical resource for manufacturing process performance and product quality.

Position specifics:

- Location: Woodstock, IL
- Schedule: Onsite
- Travel: Up to 10% travel
- Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. Charter Manufacturing is unable to sponsor employment visas at this time.

Key responsibilities:

Metallurgical & Process Engineering Leadership

- Provide technical leadership for Melt, Laboratory, and Continuous Casting processes by developing and improving metallurgical standards, manufacturing processes, and operating practices.
- Develop and improve melt recipes, process instructions, and standards for molten metal processing, product analysis, and product release.
- Evaluate and adjust manufacturing processes based on raw material quality, chemical composition, cost, product requirements, and process performance.
- Improve melting and continuous casting processes, including die and cooler design, crucible design, refractory practices, molten metal handling, and critical process variables.
- Strengthen metallurgical quality and process consistency for gray and ductile cast iron products.

Process Optimization & Technical Problem Solving

- Partner with Operations to troubleshoot manufacturing, process, and quality issues; lead root cause analysis and implement sustainable corrective actions.
- Analyze manufacturing, laboratory, quality, and process data to identify trends, reduce manufacturing losses, improve yield, and strengthen process capability.
- Lead process improvement projects through data analysis, process validation, production trials, and implementation of sustainable improvements.
- Investigate and resolve quality problems identified during manufacturing or through customer returns, including defect and failure analysis.
- Apply process engineering and continuous-improvement tools, including Design of Experiments, statistical analysis, process mapping, DMAIC, root cause analysis, and Lean principles.

Technical Systems, Projects & Product Support

- Maintain MES process master data and provide technical support for manufacturing system enhancements, troubleshooting, and process optimization.
- Support capital projects involving manufacturing equipment, tooling, furnaces, holders, refractory systems, and process improvements.
- Serve as the primary technical resource for new-product quoting by evaluating manufacturing feasibility, process capability, and technical risk.
- Partner with Procurement in qualifying new suppliers and ensuring incoming raw materials meet required technical and quality standards.
- Support the development and qualification of new or improved products, materials, manufacturing technologies, and process capabilities.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Technical Expertise

- Collaborate with Operations, Quality, Maintenance, Engineering, Supply Chain, Sales, and Technical Services to solve technical problems and support strategic initiatives.
- Support Commercial and Sales teams as a technical resource for customer application questions, quality concerns, processing recommendations, and product performance.
- Develop and maintain manufacturing standards, work instructions, operating procedures, and technical documentation.
- Share technical knowledge and mentor employees on metallurgy, materials science, process controls, manufacturing processes, and continuous-improvement practices.
- Support Environmental, Quality, and Safety Management Systems and ensure compliance with company policies and regulatory requirements.

- Bachelor’s Degree in Metallurgical Engineering, Materials Science, or a related engineering discipline.

- Strong understanding of metallurgy, materials science, cast iron manufacturing, process control, and data analysis.
- Demonstrated success solving complex technical problems and improving manufacturing processes.
- Strong analytical, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and problem-solving skills.
- Ability to lead cross-functional projects and influence others without direct authority.
- Strong verbal, written, and presentation skills.
- Experience with SolidWorks 2D/3D CAD software, or willingness to learn, to support tooling, equipment, and process improvements.
- Proficiency with Microsoft Office and manufacturing data analysis tools.
- Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
- Demonstrated commitment to safety, quality, and continuous improvement.
- Willingness to travel up to 10%.

- Master’s Degree in Metallurgical Engineering, Materials Science, Engineering, Operations Management, or a related field.
- Experience with induction melting and production of gray and ductile cast iron.
- Experience with continuous casting operations and cast iron manufacturing.
- Experience with metallurgical laboratory equipment, including optical emission spectrometers and LECO analyzers.

- Contribute to process characterization and process understanding activities by correlating manufacturing parameters with column performance outcomes.
- Identify opportunities to improve process capability, product consistency, manufacturing throughput, and yield.
- Support technology transfer, scale-up, and process validation activities as required.
- Prepare technical reports, protocols, work instructions, and investigation summaries to support manufacturing and development activities.
- Maintain laboratory and manufacturing equipment in compliance with safety and quality requirements.
- Follow established Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), quality systems, and site procedures.

- Post-graduate, certification, and/or license may be required.

title: Senior Regulatory Affairs Program Manager
description:
About The Role

Senior Regulatory Affairs Program Manager is the primary regulatory strategist and architect for our AI/ML Software as a Medical Device (SaMD) portfolio. While many companies view Regulatory Affairs as a purely administrative function, at Hinge Health we leverage this role as a technical discipline.

In this role, you will be responsible for the hands-on authorship and management of regulatory submissions (510(k), De Novo, Pre-Subs) for our cutting-edge AI products. You will partner closely with Product, Clinical, and Engineering teams to interpret the evolving FDA framework for AI/ML, helping us navigate complex pathways like Predetermined Change Control Plans (PCCP). You will also own the internal regulatory functions that support our Quality Management System, ensuring our rapid innovation remains compliant.

What You’ll Accomplish

-
Submission Leadership (AI/ML SaMD): Lead the planning, authorship, and submission of regulatory filings (510(k), De Novo, Q-Submissions) for AI/ML-enabled software. You will be the primary author, not just a reviewer, translating complex technical and clinical data into compelling regulatory narratives.

-
Regulatory Strategy & AI Policy: Develop and execute regulatory strategies for new product introductions and major software updates. You will serve as the internal authority on the FDA’s evolving AI/ML Action Plan, guiding the business on how to validate and monitor adaptive algorithms.

-
Design Control & Change Impact: Participate in Design Reviews and Change Control Boards (CCB) to assess the regulatory impact of software changes. You will determine when a new 510(k) or "Letter to File" is required, specifically evaluating changes to AI models and retraining pipelines.

-
QMS & Internal Compliance: Support the maintenance of the Quality Management System (QMS) by ensuring regulatory requirements (21 CFR 820, ISO 13485) are reflected in internal procedures. You will act as the Regulatory representative during internal and external audits (FDA, ISO).

-
Promotional Review: Review and approve labeling, marketing materials, and user manuals to ensure claims are substantiated and consistent with cleared indications for use.

-
Post-Market Surveillance & Vigilance: Partner with Quality to monitor post-market performance of AI models. You will lead the assessment of complaints for regulatory reporting requirements (e.g., eMDRs) and manage any necessary recalls or field actions.

-
Cross-Functional Coaching: Educate technical teams on regulatory principles, demystifying the submission process and helping engineers understand how their documentation directly supports regulatory clearance.

Basic Qualifications:

-
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Biomedical Engineering, Software Engineering, Regulatory Science, or a related technical/scientific field.

-
Experience: A minimum of 4-6 + years of experience in Regulatory Affairs within the medical device industry, with a minimum of 3 years focused on Software as a Medical Device (SaMD) or Digital Health.

-
Submission Expertise: Proven track record of authoring and clearing US FDA Class II submissions (510(k) or De Novo). Experience interfacing directly with FDA reviewers during the review clock.

-
Technical Fluency: Ability to understand software architecture, cloud infrastructure, and AI/ML concepts sufficiently to describe them to regulators. Familiarity with IEC 62304 and FDA Guidance on Software Validation.

Preferred Qualifications:

-
AI/ML Specifics: Direct experience with regulatory submissions involving Machine Learning, Deep Learning, or Computer Vision. Familiarity with Good Machine Learning Practice (GMLP) principles and Predetermined Change Control Plans (PCCP).

-
International Experience: Experience with international registrations, particularly EU MDR (CE Marking) for software, or Health Canada requirements.

-
Data Analysis: Ability to review statistical analysis plans and clinical validation reports to ensure they meet regulatory expectations for substantial equivalence or safety/effectiveness.

-
Agile Integration: Experience working in an Agile/Scrum environment and adapting regulatory submission timelines to iterative software release cycles.

Hinge Health leverages software, including AI, to largely automate care for joint and muscle health, delivering an outstanding member experience, improved member outcomes, and cost reductions for its clients. The company has designed its platform to address a broad spectrum of MSK care—from acute injury, to chronic pain, to post-surgical rehabilitation—and the platform can help to ease members’ pain, improve their function, and reduce their need for surgeries, all while driving health equity by allowing members to engage in their exercise therapy sessions from anywhere. description:

Twitch is the world’s biggest live streaming service, with global communities built around gaming, entertainment, music, sports, cooking, and more. It is where thousands of communities come together for whatever, every day.

About the Role

Twitch's Enterprise Platform & Technology (EPT) organization is looking for a Software Development Engineer II to build the systems where SAP meets AWS — extending our enterprise ERP with cloud-native services and agentic AI to power Finance and enterprise functions across Twitch and Amazon. This is a hands-on engineering role where you'll work on SAP-side development (ABAP, CDS, RAP, OData) and AWS-native engineering (Lambda, Step Functions, MCP servers, Bedrock, CDK) — owning integrations end-to-end.

You'll work at the intersection of SAP enterprise systems and modern cloud engineering — building AWS-hosted APIs and pipelines that talk to SAP, standing up agentic AI tooling (MCP servers, Bedrock agents, Claude-powered workflows) that automates Finance operations, and shipping production AWS services alongside SAP customizations. The business problems are well understood; how you solve them with SAP + AWS + AI is up to you. We're looking for an SAP developer whose toolkit has grown past the ERP — someone who writes ABAP inside SAP GUI and is just as ready to pick up Python or TypeScript to ship the cloud half of their own integration, and who raises the bar on automation along the way.

Build in SAP

- Design, build, and maintain integrations between SAP (S/4HANA, BTP) and downstream systems — owning the full lifecycle from design through operations

- Write ABAP, SAP HANA SQL, and CDS views to implement business logic, reports, and data transformations within the SAP ecosystem

- Design, build, and maintain SAP APIs — OData services (SEGW / RAP), RESTful APIs, SOAP web services, and RFC-based interfaces — for consumption by external systems, Fiori apps, and AWS-hosted middleware

Extend it with AWS and agentic AI

- Build and operate AWS-native services (Lambda, Step Functions, API Gateway, S3, DynamoDB, ECS/Fargate, Amazon ECR) that extend SAP capabilities beyond the traditional ERP boundary

- Deploy and manage the AWS infrastructure behind your integrations using CDK (TypeScript/Python) — including CI/CD pipelines, IAM roles, VPC/VPCE connectivity to SAP, and multi-environment topology (beta/gamma/prod)

- Build data pipelines that move financial data between SAP, Redshift, and enterprise applications

Cross-cutting

- Collaborate with Finance, Accounting, and Tax stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions delivered across SAP and AWS

- Own production systems end-to-end — deployment, monitoring, incident response, and iterative improvement

- Improve engineering practices on the team through code reviews, documentation, and mentoring

You Have

SAP

- 4+ years of hands-on SAP development experience (ABAP, HANA SQL, CDS views, BTP, or SAP integration technologies like BAPIs, RFC)

- Experience building integrations using File-Based and API-Based (REST, OData, SOAP) patterns

- Experience with the S/4HANA top-down development approach — CDS views (with associations, annotations, parameters) and AMDP classes to push data processing to HANA from the ABAP layer

AWS and AI

- Hands-on experience with AWS services (Lambda, S3, Step Functions, DynamoDB, IAM, API Gateway, or similar) — deploying and operating production workloads

- Proficiency in at least one modern language beyond ABAP — Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, or Java — with a demonstrated track record of shipping production code

- Experience with infrastructure-as-code (CDK, Terraform, or CloudFormation) — writing, deploying, and reviewing IaC in a team setting

- Demonstrated heavy use of AI tools (Claude, Copilot, Bedrock, or similar) integrated into your daily engineering workflow — code generation, data analysis, automation, and problem-solving

Shared

- Strong understanding of object-oriented design patterns (Factory, Strategy, Observer, Template Method) and SOLID principles

Bonus Points

title: Senior Director, Medical Affairs Biostatistics
description:
Company Overview:

Dyne Therapeutics is focused on delivering functional improvement for people living with genetically driven neuromuscular diseases. We are developing therapeutics that target muscle and the central nervous system (CNS) to address the root cause of disease. The company is advancing clinical programs for Duchenne muscular dystrophy (DMD) and myotonic dystrophy type 1 (DM1) as well as preclinical programs for facioscapulohumeral muscular dystrophy (FSHD), Pompe disease and multiple DMD mutations. At Dyne, we are on a mission to deliver functional improvement for individuals, families and communities. Learn more at https://www.dyne-tx.com/, and follow us on X, LinkedIn and Facebook.

Role Summary:

The Senior Director, Medical Affairs Biostatistics provides strategic, technical, and operational leadership for biostatistics across Medical Affairs evidence-generation activities. This role serves as the primary statistical partner to Medical Affairs leadership and is accountable for shaping statistically rigorous, fit-for-purpose evidence strategies that support scientific communication, external engagement, payer and access needs, and lifecycle planning. Areas of responsibility include Phase IV studies, real-world evidence, observational research, secondary and exploratory analyses of clinical development data, investigator-sponsored research, clinical outcomes assessment (PRO/HRQoL), HEOR and value evidence activities, scientific publications, congress presentations, and other Medical Affairs evidence-generation initiatives. The role requires the ability to operate with a high degree of independence, influence cross-functional and senior stakeholders, translate complex statistical concepts into actionable insights, and build scalable processes, standards, and capabilities. Experience in rare disease drug development, preferably neuromuscular disease, is preferred.

This role is based in Waltham, MA.

Primary Responsibilities Include:

Strategic Leadership and Evidence Planning

- Serve as the senior Biostatistics lead and subject matter expert for Medical Affairs, providing strategic direction, independent statistical judgment, and hands-on statistical leadership

- Shape integrated evidence-generation strategies and product-level evidence plans in partnership with Medical Affairs, Clinical Development, HEOR, Value & Access, Regulatory, and Commercial stakeholders

- Represent Biostatistics on cross-functional Medical Affairs and evidence-generation teams, influencing strategic decisions and ensuring statistical approaches are scientifically rigorous, practical, and aligned with business and patient needs

Study Design, Analysis, and Evidence Generation

- Lead statistical strategy, study design, methodology, and execution for Phase IV, observational, registry, and real-world evidence studies

- Lead secondary, exploratory, and post hoc analyses of clinical development data to support Medical Affairs strategy, scientific exchange, publications, congress presentations, payer evidence, and lifecycle planning

- Provide statistical expertise to HEOR, Value & Access, HTA, and payer-related activities, including methods for evidence generation, interpretation, and communication to external stakeholders

- Provide statistical leadership for clinical outcomes assessment, including PRO/HRQoL analysis, psychometric evaluation, score derivation, endpoint interpretation, and evidence to support publications, payer dossiers, and potential label-enabling activities

Scientific Communication and Cross-Functional Partnership

- Lead the statistical strategy for Medical Affairs publications and scientific communications, including manuscripts, abstracts, congress presentations, advisory boards, investigator-sponsored research, and external scientific collaborations

- Partner with Clinical Development Biostatistics to leverage complementary expertise, ensure consistency across the product lifecycle, and maintain alignment between development, regulatory, and Medical Affairs analyses

- Analyze, interpret, and communicate complex results to cross-functional teams, senior leadership, external collaborators, and non-technical audiences in a clear and actionable manner

Operational Excellence and Vendor Oversight

- Develop, review, and execute analysis plans, supplemental statistical analysis plans, table/listing/figure shells, dataset specifications, and associated documentation to ensure high-quality, inspection-ready statistical deliverables

- Partner closely with Data Management, Statistical Programming, Clinical Operations, and external vendors to ensure fit-for-purpose data, efficient study execution, and high-quality, timely statistical deliverables supporting Medical Affairs studies and evidence-generation initiatives

- Provide oversight of CROs, consultants, and external vendors, including scope, quality, timelines, resourcing, issue escalation, and delivery of statistical services

Functional Leadership and Team Development

- Drive standardization, process improvement, templates, best practices, and functional standards within Biostatistics and across cross-functional teams

- Manage, mentor, and develop direct reports and other statistical colleagues through direct management, matrix leadership, and technical mentorship, fostering technical excellence, collaboration, accountability, and a high-performing team environment

Education and Skills Requirements:

- PhD in Statistics, Biostatistics, or a related quantitative discipline with 10+ years of relevant pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or health-related industry experience; or MS with 12+ years of relevant experience

- Demonstrated experience leading the design, analysis, interpretation, and reporting of analyses within Medical Affairs, including Phase IV, observational, registry, and real-world evidence studies

- Experience supporting scientific publications, congress presentations, investigator-sponsored research, and external scientific engagement, including collaboration with investigators and presentation of statistical findings

- Strong expertise in statistical methodology relevant to observational and real-world research, including study design, bias and confounding, causal inference, longitudinal analysis, missing data, endpoint strategy, and time-to-event methods

- Advanced SAS programming skills are required; experience with R and familiarity with contemporary tools and approaches for real-world data analysis are preferred. Ability to perform, review, and oversee statistical analyses

- Experience overseeing CROs, consultants, and external vendors, including scope management, quality oversight, timelines, and deliverables

- Demonstrated experience leading and developing statisticians through direct management, matrix leadership, technical mentorship, or functional capability-building

- Ability to independently prioritize and manage multiple concurrent priorities and deliverables in a fast-paced, matrixed biotechnology environment

- Strong analytical judgment and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work through ambiguity, anticipate risks, and recommend practical, scientifically sound solutions

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to effectively communicate complex statistical concepts to technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leaders and external stakeholders

- Experience in rare disease, preferably neuromuscular disease, is preferred

- Interest in and basic understanding of biology and biological processes, including ASO and siRNA modalities

- Validate models against lab measurements. Perform data fitting and statistical analysis to align model parameters with real-world silicon performance.

- Actively collaborate with design, analog, digital and architecture engineers to deliver high impact tape-outs

Qualifications

- Master’s +5 years experience or PhD +3 years experience in Electrical Engineering, Photonics, Physics, or related field.

- Deep understanding of photonic device physics and experience in device simulation.

- Experience building behavioral models for circuit simulators (e.g., Lumerical INTERCONNECT, Cadence, Synopsys OptSim, or custom Python solvers).

- Experienced in Python for modeling, automation, and data analysis. Comfortable with object-oriented programming and scientific libraries (NumPy, SciPy).

- Python based layout experience.

- Demonstrated strong problem solving skills for problems without obvious solutions

- Proficiency with python-based layout tools such as gdstk, GDSFactory, and KLayout

- Prior experience in using foundry-provided process design kits (PDKs), adhering to specific design rules and constraints, well understanding of DRC, LVS, etc.

title: Senior Architect, Data and Analytics
description:
Summary

As a Senior Architect for the Data and Analytics team, at Guidewire you will participate in a leadership capacity collaborating with our customers and SI Partners who are adopting our Guidewire Data Platform as the centerpiece of their data foundation. You will work to drive consensus among all participants and assist customers embarking on enterprise data transformation initiatives achieve their goals adhering to Guidewire best practices and standards.

One of our principles is to have fun while we deliver, so this role will need to keep the delivery process fun and engaging for the team in collaboration with the broader organization. Given the dynamic nature of the work in the Data and Analytics team, we are looking for decisive, highly-skilled technical and business problem solvers who are self-motivated and take proactive actions for the benefit of our customers and ensure that they succeed in their journey to Guidewire Cloud Platform and realize the value of their Data Assets like Cloud Data Access (CDA), DataStudio, and Explore post migration. You will collaborate closely with teams located around the world and adhere to our core values Integrity, Collegiality, and Rationality.

Job Description

-
You will design and propose high level design diagrams for overall system architecture and adopt AI forward thinking.

-
You will lead Inception Sessions to build consensus on project scope, and generate user stories with acceptance criteria and contribute actively to the evolution and fine tuning of Guidewire Vantage Methodology.

-
You will work closely with business analysts to derive Data Management and Analytics technical solutions from Business Requirements Documents.

-

-
You will analyze complex data structures in legacy source systems and help the business and data analysts to map them to the Guidewire InsuranceSuite data model. You will accelerate the processes by adopting AI forward thinking and actively optimizing and AI enabling all of Guidewire Data Platform and analytics offerings.

-
You will manage the end-to-end data loading process, including pre-load validation, execution of load jobs, and post-load verification.

-

You will enable offshore teams to be successful in delivering agreed upon business requirements while conforming to Guidewire best practices & standards.

-
Work with the PMO providing domain expertise to achieve successful project outcomes.

-
Lead efforts to harvest project collateral to build out collateral to enable repeatability.

-
Create new tooling to streamline data processing when called upon or when the opportunity presents itself

-
Systematic problem-solving approach, coupled with a sense of ownership and drive

-
Ability to work independently in a fast-paced Agile environment

-
At Guidewire, we foster a culture of curiosity, innovation, and responsible use of AI—empowering our teams to continuously leverage emerging technologies and data-driven insights to enhance productivity and outcomes.

-
Guidewire consultants are expected to spend up to 50% of their time on-site with the customer business and technical teams.

-
Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Computer Science, or equivalent level of demonstrable professional competency

-
8+ years in a Senior technical role building out complex Data Integration frameworks.

-
Deep understanding of the P&C insurance domain, including concepts like policies, claims, billing, and underwriting.

-
Strong knowledge of Business Intelligence and Data Warehousing concepts. 5+ years of experience in Data Warehousing projects

-
5+ years of Experience with leading BI developers and architects to deliver complete solution stacks.

-
5+ years of Experience with data processing and ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) and ELT (Extract, Load, and Transform) concepts.

-
At least 3 years of experience leading design review sessions to build consensus among diverse groups of technical and business participants.

-
At least 3 years in a leadership capacity for delivering complex data transformation initiatives including mentoring and team building.

-
Experience working in Guidewire Data Migration/Data Platform projects.

-
Experience working with relational databases

-
Experience working with customer teams to understand business objectives and functional requirements.

-
Effective leadership, interpersonal, and communication skills.

-
Ability to work independently and within a team.

-
Demonstrated ability to embrace AI and apply it to your current role as well as data-driven insights to drive innovation, productivity, and continuous improvement.

Nice to have:

-
Familiarity in Change Data Capture (CDC) frameworks

Experience with NoSQL databases

Experience working with different cloud platforms (such as AWS, DataBricks, Azure, Snowflake, Google Cloud, etc.)

Experience in adopting AI platforms like Claude code to deliver business value and reduce implementation cycle time.

title: GTM Operations Analyst – Analytics & Automation
description:

title: Digital Consultant
description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Summary

The Digital Consultant is a trusted partner who creates customized integrated solutions with healthcare laboratory customers. Through workflow analysis, process assessments, and collaborative design, this role improves the efficiency, quality, and operational performance of the diagnostics market. Combining technical expertise with business acumen, you serve as a core digital and workflow subject matter expert across diverse healthcare and laboratory environments.

This field-based digital consultant influences local and regional decisions early in the sales process by translating customer needs into tangible value demonstrations. Combining technical expertise in diagnostic solutions with strong stakeholder engagement, the digital consultant ensures solutions deliver measurable clinical, operational, and financial outcomes that drive customer satisfaction and Roche's growth.

KEY ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES:

Strategic Leadership & Subject Matter Expertise

- Design differentiated digital solutions balancing customer value with business sustainability.
- Adopt and execute "Standard Work" across franchises and global teams to ensure consistent quality and delivery.
- Support consulting engagements for local and regional projects, leveraging standard analytical methods and cross-functional coordination.
- Apply validated approaches such as Lean and Six Sigma for pre- and post-sales consulting.
- Seek to offer the best technical solution and process improvements linked to financial viability for the customer and Roche.
- Deliver foundational digital consulting services including workflow planning, process analysis, future-state design, and change management.
- Master key tools: Total Value of Ownership (TVO), ROI analysis and Salesforce.
- Ensure proper project handoff to implementation teams with agreed deliverables.
- Provide feedback to help refine and evolve proprietary tools, techniques, and methodologies within the Digital Consulting (DC) practice.

Pre-Sales & Customer Advisory

- Provide pre-sales support to customers and sales teams for the development of recommended complex diagnostic intelligent integrated solutions, including tangible value propositions (ROIs, before and after analysis).
- Partner with Sales and Regional Accounts to identify opportunities and integrate digital consulting data into tactical business planning and account management.
- Utilize Strategic Visioning and Co-Creation methodologies to help customers define their operational direction, ensuring Roche digital solutions are central to their objectives.
- Monitor sales opportunities for which projects have been developed until the customers’ final decision, in alignment with the commercial organization.

Internal & External Communication

- Communicate, internally and outside RDC, the value of Digital Consulting services through written documents, case studies, marketing materials, and internal knowledge sharing.
- Represent Digital Consulting as a credible advisor within the local industry and customer community.

Quality Assurance & Continuous Improvement

- Collect and provide feedback (voice of the customer input) to ensure Digital Consulting solutions are meeting client needs and functioning according to specifications.
- Collaborate with fellow Roche Consulting colleagues to use, refine, and evolve proprietary tools and techniques to generate high-value deliverables and best practices.
- Continuously support the improvement of the overall consulting solution offering, products, and services Roche supports based on customer insights.
- Assist customer, support service, and IT teams in implementing detailed customer installation requirements to ensure customers’ needs have been met and that the product or solution is fully functioning according to expectations.

Administrative & Compliance

- Perform related administrative duties such as creating and submitting expense reports and status reports and adhere to any additional regulatory requirements.

WHO YOU ARE:

You are an agile and analytical consultant with a proven track record of navigating complex laboratory and matrixed healthcare environments to drive operational improvement. You excel at managing diverse stakeholder relationships and translating site-level operational needs into actionable project objectives that deliver long-term value. Your expertise lies in workflow optimization, data analysis, and the ability to guide customers through change by anchoring recommendations in data. You possess the collaborative acumen to work effectively across specialized internal teams, fostering a culture of execution and continuous improvement across the Roche Consulting organization.

Our ideal candidate would reside on the western half of the USA or in the Northeast within 50 miles of a major airport.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

- Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Medical Technology, Life Sciences AND 4 years of laboratory IT, general IT, product line experience

OR

- 6 years experience of laboratory IT, general IT, product line experience

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- 5+ years of experience in the diagnostics, healthcare, or manufacturing industry in Operations, Engineering, Quality, Regulatory, or equivalent
- Experience with process mapping, statistical analysis, and reporting tools.
- Strong verbal and written communication skills to influence customer decision-makers by articulating data-driven ideas and influencing adoption of solutions.

- Able to travel +75% of the time.
- MLT/MLS/MB ASCP certification, HT/HTL ASCP certification or equivalent.
- Strong regulatory knowledge of CAP, CLIA, and TJC.
- Black Belt certification in Lean Six Sigma, a relevant advanced degree (e.g., Lean Manufacturing, Operations Management), or validated equivalent enterprise continuous improvement experience
- 3+ years of commercial experience in a sales, service-oriented, or consulting environment.
- Proficiency using Laboratory Information Systems (LIS) and Middleware; familiarity with the navify Portfolio.
- Strong organization and analytical skills to uncover key technical, operational, and strategic issues.
- Ability to use analytical methods and applications to support consulting engagement conclusions and recommendations.
- Ability to credibly recommend changes to laboratory practices to improve waste, cost, quality, and turnaround times.
- Strong interpersonal skills to effectively influence and collaborate with people at various organizational levels internally and within customer organizations.
- Familiarity with Roche and/or competitor products and industry trends.

Additional Information

- Relocation benefits are not provided with this position.
- A company car is provided with this position.

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Indianapolis is $100,100.00 to $185,900.00 USD Annually. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance. This position also qualifies for the benefits detailed at the link provided below.

Benefits

Who we are

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.
