title: Senior Customer Analytics & Measurement Lead
description:
Company Description

Blend is a premier AI services provider, committed to co-creating meaningful impact for its clients through the power of data science, AI, technology, and people. With a mission to fuel bold visions, Blend tackles significant challenges by seamlessly aligning human expertise with artificial intelligence. The company is dedicated to unlocking value and fostering innovation for its clients by harnessing world-class people and data-driven strategy. We believe that the power of people and AI can have a meaningful impact on your world, creating more fulfilling work and projects for our people and clients.

Job Description

Our client is a leading telecommunications and connectivity company serving millions of customers across the United States. As part of a broader Customer 360 initiative, they are seeking a Senior Customer Analytics & Measurement Lead to partner closely with an analytics professional and senior business leaders to translate customer insights into actionable programs, business recommendations, and measurable outcomes.

This is a highly business-facing role for an experienced analytics and strategy professional who can take analytical findings, develop the story behind the data, and build organizational alignment around what the insights mean and what the business should do next. The ideal candidate combines customer analytics experience with strong consulting, communication, and executive stakeholder management skills.

The Details:

- Role level: Senior Manager to Director
- Location: Hybrid 3 days per week onsite in Stamford, CT
- Duration: Long-term consulting role through 2027 (must be able to work on Blend’s W2 without requiring employer sponsorship either now or in the future)
- Benefits: We do offer benefits to our full-time consultants and employees, including Health, Vision, Dental, 401K plan, Life Insurance, Employee Assistance Programs, and an incredibly supportive team cheering you on!

What you’ll do:

Customer Analytics & Business Strategy

- Partner closely with an analytics professional to identify meaningful findings from customer data and translate those findings into actionable business opportunities.
- Develop compelling stories and recommendations that connect analytical insights to customer needs, business priorities, and potential programs.
- Help shape prospective customer programs and initiatives by identifying opportunities to improve customer growth, engagement, and retention.
- Support the development of customer targeting strategies by identifying signals and insights that can inform campaign opportunities.
- Bring a strong understanding of customer behavior, business performance, and measurement to help determine where analytical findings can have the greatest business impact.

Measurement & Outcomes

- Define how customer initiatives and programs should be measured and establish clear measures of success.
- Develop measurement approaches for initiatives designed to drive outcomes such as customer upsell, monthly recurring revenue growth, and retention.
- Partner with analytics resources to evaluate program performance and determine whether initiatives are achieving their intended outcomes.
- Translate performance results into clear business implications and recommendations for future action.
- Help establish a consistent connection between customer insights, business initiatives, and measurable outcomes.

Executive Stakeholder Engagement

- Present customer insights, recommendations, and measurement approaches to senior leaders, including VPs, SVPs, and senior directors.
- Build organizational alignment around customer metrics, programs, priorities, and definitions of success.
- Influence stakeholders across a large, matrixed organization and build support for recommended actions.
- Navigate differing perspectives and priorities while maintaining focus on the business objective and supporting recommendations with facts, analysis, and relevant experience.
- Communicate complex analytical findings in a clear, concise, and compelling way for executive audiences.
- Bring confidence, professionalism, and executive polish to senior-level client conversations.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Work closely with the Customer 360 program team and maintain strong alignment across Blend and client stakeholders.
- Partner with analytics, marketing, customer strategy, and business teams to connect customer findings to potential programs and campaigns.
- Coordinate closely with the analytics lead to ensure findings are accurately understood, appropriately contextualized, and translated into business recommendations.
- Provide regular updates and reporting to both Blend and client stakeholders.
- Help move initiatives from insight and recommendation through stakeholder alignment, action, and outcome measurement.

Analytics & Business Intelligence

- Use dashboards and business intelligence tools such as Tableau to understand customer trends, performance, and analytical findings.
- Interpret analytical outputs and identify the business implications behind the numbers.
- Use data as a foundation for recommendations rather than simply reporting on metrics.
- Leverage emerging AI-enabled tools, including ChatGPT or Claude, to support analysis, synthesize findings, develop insights, and prepare executive presentations.
- This is a business-facing analytics role, not a technical analytics or BI development position. The role does not require hands-on dashboard development, SQL, Python, or data engineering expertise.

Qualifications

Experience & Background

- Senior-level experience in customer analytics, customer strategy, marketing analytics, measurement, business strategy, consulting, or related discipline.
- Experience translating analytical findings into business recommendations, programs, or strategic initiatives.
- Demonstrated ability to influence decisions and drive action across a complex organization.
- Experience working with senior business stakeholders and presenting to executive audiences.
- Consulting, professional services, or client-facing experience is strongly preferred.
- Experience on the business side owning or influencing a measurement product, customer analytics program, or similar capability is also highly relevant.
- Experience supporting customer growth, retention, upsell, lifecycle marketing, or campaign targeting initiatives is a plus.

Analytics & Measurement Skills

- Strong understanding of customer analytics and business performance measurement.
- Ability to interpret dashboards and business intelligence outputs, including tools such as Tableau.
- Ability to identify meaningful trends and insights and connect them to business opportunities.
- Experience defining KPIs, success measures, or measurement frameworks for business initiatives.
- Strong analytical thinking with the ability to support recommendations using facts, data, and business experience.
- Advanced data visualization or dashboard development is not required.

Communication & Influence

- Exceptional executive communication and presentation skills.
- Demonstrated ability to build alignment and persuade stakeholders across functions and levels of an organization.
- Confidence challenging assumptions and advocating for recommendations when supported by data and experience.
- Ability to turn complex analytical findings into clear, compelling business stories.
- Strong PowerPoint skills and the ability to develop polished executive presentations.
- Comfortable operating with senior leaders and navigating a large, matrixed corporate environment.

Leadership & Collaboration

- Strategic, business-minded, and highly collaborative.
- Able to move beyond simply owning a metric or dashboard to influence what the organization does with the information.
- Comfortability operating in an environment where priorities and recommendations may need to evolve based on new insights.
- Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple stakeholders and priorities.
- Professional, polished, confident, and able to establish credibility quickly with senior client leaders.

Additional Information

The starting pay range for this role is $75-80 per hour. Actual compensation within the range will be dependent on several factors including but not limited to relevant experience, skills, certifications, training, and location. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range and determining factors for compensation are considered for each individual circumstance. BLEND360 also offers a competitive benefits program to meet the health and financial well-being of our team and their families. You can look forward to a range of benefits including medical, dental, vision, 401K, PTO, commuter benefits, spending accounts, life insurance, disability coverage, and EAPs.

A diverse workforce is a strong workforce

To deliver growth at BLEND360 and for our clients, we believe as a Talent Solutions Company, we have a responsibility and unique opportunity to positively impact the workforce. Diversity has played a critical role in our history, our growth, and continues to have a profound impact on our success. We are determined to have equality in the workplace, within our team and as an extension of our clients’ team.

BLEND360 is an equal opportunity employer.

Consultant, Analytics & Insights, Revenue Cycle
description:
Consultant, Analytics & Insights (Revenue Cycle)

Believe in better.

This is a remote role that may require some occasional travel.

Role Overview

As Chartis accelerates its evolution into a more tech and AI-forward enterprise, this role sits within the Strategic Intelligence & Technology (SIT) organization—built to enable internal and external transformation through modern technology, data, and analytics capabilities that advance healthcare AI and digital transformation and deliver new insights to our clients.

-

-

-

-
Proficiency in SQL for querying, data extraction, and basic transformations.

-
Familiarity with BI tools (Power BI, Tableau). Exposure to Snowflake or other cloud-based data platforms preferred.

-
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, applying quantitative techniques to identify trends, diagnose issues, and developing evidence-based recommendations.

-
Skilled collaborator who partners effectively with client teams to frame data challenges, co-develop solutions, and substantiate recommendations with data-driven insights.

-
Proven ability to independently manage workstreams or projects, demonstrating initiative, accountability, and exceptional attention to detail.

-
Strong understanding of organizational KPIs and the ability to link analytics and recommendations to strategic performance goals.

Apply to be one of our next Wetland and Waterway Permit and Enforcement Coordinators (Natural Resource Specialist 3) by October 21st, 2026! Our agency has 2 (two) openings as well as an opening for a Wetland Ecologist, (REQ-207804). All are welcome to apply; current state employees are encouraged to apply to these positions as a job rotation by including written approval from their current supervisor.

These are both full-time, limited duration positions expected to last through June 30th, 2028, and there may be an opportunity to extend. These positions are eligible for a hybrid remote schedule based out of our Salem office, with required in-office days the first week and two (2) times per week (Tuesdays and Thursdays) for the following four weeks and then 2-3 times per month for the duration of the position. The successful candidates must be able to travel to site visits within Oregon on short notice and, within six months of hiring, live within a reasonable commuting distance to the Salem office.

Our stewardship ensures vital natural and financial resources contribute to a vibrant, healthy Oregon now and forever. The DSL team makes a difference for Oregonians every day. As a Wetland and Waterway Permit and Enforcement Coordinator, you will too.

The primary purpose of these positions is to represent the regulatory program of the Department of State Lands. This includes issuing Removal-Fill Permits, reviewing monitoring reports for compensatory mitigation, and conducting compliance for authorized and unauthorized activities.

What’s In It for You?

-
- Utilize your skills and experience in natural resources to protect Oregon’s waterways and wetlands through the state’s Removal-Fill Law while engaging the public, government agencies, and other interested parties.
- Receive 1-on-1 mentoring and support from natural resource experts.

- Possibly qualify for the Student Loan Forgiveness Program.
- Earn the initial monthly salary range for this position starting at $5,320 - $8,141 for employees new to public service. After 6 months, you will receive a 6.95% increase with 6% going to your PERS retirement.

- NOTE: Starting pay is determined by a pay equity analysis, which is partly based on the number of years of relevant experience.

These positions will report directly to our main Salem office. They are full-time, limited duration positions represented by the American Federation of State, County, and Municipal Employees (AFSCME).

Working Conditions

The successful candidates will primarily work in an office environment with regular and full day of computer use and periods of fast-paced activity and competing priorities. The positions require the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously, including meeting high-priority deadlines.

Travel is an essential function of the positions. They may require site visits performed on the same day as the request. Occasional fieldwork may involve walking along and within waterways, on uneven terrain, on wet and muddy ground, and without pathways in all types of weather. Occasional overnight stays and/or extended work hours may occur along with exposure to inclement weather, field, and road conditions. Work can at times be in remote locations. DSL provides agency-maintained vehicles, field gear reimbursement, and travel expenses for authorized work-related travel and fieldwork.

As our Wetland and Waterway Permit and Enforcement Coordinator, you will have the opportunity to:

- Agency Representation. Serve as a DSL representative for entities including the Governor’s Office Regional Solutions Teams, permit applicants, other agencies, members of the public, and industry professionals.

- Review Removal-Fill Applications. Evaluate removal-fill permit applications and provide recommendations for DSL decisions. This includes reviewing and interpreting function and value assessments, alternatives analyses, compensatory mitigation plans, rectification plans, engineering drawings, and evaluating direct and indirect impacts to waters of this state.

- Perform Compliance Monitoring. Investigate projects, conduct site visits, and review reports to assess compliance with permit conditions and evaluate the functions and values of jurisdictional waters.

- Jurisdictional Determinations. Aid in state jurisdictional determinations within jurisdictional waters.

- Carrying Out Enforcement Responsibilities. Investigate wetland and waterway complaints and process violations of the Removal-Fill Law.

- undefined

Three (3) years of experience in aquatic natural resources. At least one year of the experience must be at a technical level or professional level performing activities in a natural resource program such as analyzing data, conducting investigations, applying pertinent laws and regulations, or coordinating and monitoring project activities.

AND

a bachelor’s degree in a natural resource field such as biology, ecology, natural resources, or environmental science, or

OR

three (3) additional years of related experience.

A doctorate degree in a natural resource field such as biology, ecology, or environmental science will substitute for up to two (2) years of the required experience.

Experience interpreting and explaining environmental regulations or programs to a wide variety of technical and non-technical audiences including public, private, and government entities.

- GPS/GIS Skills. Using GPS and GIS software, such as ArcGIS Pro, for data analysis and mapping.

- Teamwork & Problem Solving. Demonstrated ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team, including strong conflict resolution abilities.

title: Senior Mechanical Engineer, Motorized Blower Development
description:
Design the technology that helps power better breathing.

Join Resmed’s motorized blower new product development team and help create the mechanical systems at the heart of products designed to improve people’s health. As a Senior Mechanical Engineer, you will design, develop, prototype and test motorized blowers and their components, turning engineering requirements into robust designs that can be manufactured at scale.

Your key deliverables will include mechanical specifications, tolerance analyses, layouts, engineering drawings, technical proposals, test protocols and verification evidence. You will guide project work, mentor junior colleagues and bring sound engineering judgement to decisions that affect product fit, form and function.

This is a hybrid role in Calabasas, California.

What You’ll Do

- Design motorized blower systems, components and assemblies for new products and improvements to existing products.
- Define mechanical specifications that support reliable manufacture and confirm that designs meet product requirements.
- Produce mechanical designs, tolerance analyses, layouts and engineering drawings using established document and change-control processes.
- Build and evaluate prototypes, then plan and execute engineering tests for blowers and related components.
- Analyse test data, document findings and communicate clear recommendations through reports and technical proposals.
- Author and execute protocols for product testing, verification and validation against defined requirements and specifications.
- Assess design risks and potential effects on product fit, form and function, using structured risk-management methods and FMEA.
- Collaborate with Systems Engineering to quantify how blower-level risks may affect the downstream flow generator.
- Apply engineering principles across motor design, rotor and structural dynamics, acoustics, vibration, machine design, fluid dynamics, statistics, numerical methods and engineering economics.
- Lead project-team activities, provide technical direction and formally mentor or train junior engineers.
- Work across manufacturing, quality, operations, procurement, supplier alliance and customer groups to gather input and ensure designs are appropriate for their intended requirements.
- Contribute to the development and refinement of manufacturing processes for the product.
- Use root-cause analysis and structured problem-solving methods to investigate technical issues and support sound design decisions.
- Perform other related duties as required to support the team’s development priorities.

What You Bring

- Tertiary qualifications in Mechanical, Electrical or Mechatronics Engineering, or a closely related discipline.
- Expertise with plastic-part design and design for plastic injection moulding.
- Ability to use Creo or Pro/E CAD software and PDM or Intralink.
- Experience with risk management and FMEA.
- Experience working with controlled documents, engineering change processes, engineering drawings, and geometric dimensioning and tolerancing.
- Ability to apply statistical analysis techniques, including the use of Minitab or JMP.
- Familiarity in root-cause analysis and recognised structured problem-solving methods.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical findings to peers and management.

Nice to have

- Understanding of manufacturing operations, the product development lifecycle or the broader Resmed business.
- Knowledge of motors, rotary components, sound, noise and vibration theory, testing equipment and data analysis.
- Experience with FEA software such as ANSYS, high-volume manufacturing or a highly regulated industry, preferably medical devices.

What Sets You Apart

- Sound judgement: You weigh evidence, risk and product requirements before recommending a path forward.
- Constructive leadership: You give clear direction, share knowledge and help junior colleagues build confidence and capability.
- Collaborative approach: You seek input from different functions and turn varied perspectives into practical engineering decisions.
- Adaptability: You respond calmly when technical priorities shift and remain focused on the quality of the outcome.
- Positive challenge: You raise concerns directly, handle disagreement respectfully and work towards solutions that protect the product and the customer.
- Ownership: You work with a high level of autonomy, follow through on commitments and communicate issues early.

Why Join Resmed

At Resmed, your engineering work contributes to technology designed to help people breathe better and live healthier, longer lives. This role offers the chance to shape motorized blower products from design through testing and validation, while working with specialists across engineering and the wider business. You will have meaningful technical scope, opportunities to guide others and a clear connection between your decisions and the performance of products used in healthcare.

Benefits and Compensation

At Resmed, we're shaping the future by investing in our people through competitive pay, flexible work arrangements, and programs that support personal and professional growth.

Benefits (employees regularly scheduled to work 30+ hours per week) include:

- Medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, and disability insurance
- HSA, FSA, commuter benefits, and sleep care management
- 401(k), ESPP, EAP, and tuition assistance
- 15 days PTO in the first year for hourly employees / FTO for salaried employees
- 11 paid holidays plus 3 floating holidays
- Up to 14 weeks primary caregiver leave or 2 weeks secondary caregiver leave

Compensation: Compensation is based on factors including geographic location, qualifications, experience, skills, and internal equity.

Pay Range: $147,000 - $184,000 USD annually

Resmed generally does not hire at or near the top of the pay range. For remote positions outside the U.S., compensation is determined based on geographic location, qualifications, experience, and skills.

title: Senior Associate, Risk and Structuring Analytics
description:
What The Role Is

Clearway Energy seeks a Senior Associate of Risk and Structuring Analytics to develop top-notch quantitative models that drive BESS valuation, structured products pricing, gas generation optimization, and power market analysis, while also quantifying and monitoring the risk exposures those positions create. In this role, you will build and enhance Clearway’s internal quantitative modeling platform (CWENQuant), develop advanced BESS dispatch optimization and price forecasting models, and provide independent risk analytics — mark-to-market, value-at-risk, credit, and scenario/stress analysis — that directly inform commercial decisions across trading, origination, development, and asset management.

What You'll Be Doing

Quantitative/Economic Modeling

- Develop and deploy to production complex optimization models and quantitative analysis for BESS dispatch optimization, renewables, gas generation, and data center infrastructure projects across the US.

- Develop Stochastic or Machine Learning / Deep Learning models to forecast DA, Ancillary, and RT prices based on fundamental variables such as load, gas prices, and wind + solar generation to inform trading.

- Develop and maintain gas dispatch, HRCO, toll, and other structured pricing models; perform mark-to-market analysis; support due diligence, underwriting, and credit analytics.

- Refine vendor models or develop in-house models for capacity expansion with a view on market policy (RPS/GHG reduction), LCOEs, retirements, transmission, reliability, and demand growth.

- Benchmark models against actual operations and market outcomes to improve forecast accuracy and optimization.

- Build and enhance CWENQuant; develop data pipelines with internal and external resources; create automated workflows and market data dashboards using data science and optimization techniques.

- Design and maintain mark-to-market (MtM), Value-at-Risk (VaR), and Profit-at-Risk (PaR) frameworks across BESS, gas, and structured product positions, independent of the deal/trading desks that originate them.

- Run scenario, sensitivity, and stress-testing analyses (price shocks, volatility regimes, basis blowouts, extreme weather/renewable generation outcomes) to quantify tail risk in the portfolio.

- Quantify hedge effectiveness and basis risk for structured transactions, PPAs, and tolling/HRCO arrangements; recommend hedge adjustments.

What You'll Bring

- Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Finance, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, or a related field.

- 3+ years of quantitative or modeling experience within the energy sector, including trading firms, banks, utilities, IPPs, ISOs, or BESS companies.

- Working experience developing ML/DL models using scikit-learn, Keras, or TensorFlow.

- Experience with linear/Mixed Integer programming and associated tools like PuLP, Gurobi, CPLEX, etc.

- Strong quantitative background with deep hands-on experience coding in Python.

- Knowledge of BESS (strongly preferred), renewable, and conventional (gas) assets, HRCO, and toll modeling.

- Strong understanding of power market economics, wholesale market structure, and asset operations in ISO (CAISO, ERCOT, etc.) markets.

- Proven ability to build top-notch optimization models and stochastic or ML/DL forecasting frameworks such as price, load, or renewable generation forecasting.

- Understanding of option pricing, volatility, game theory, opportunity cost, and optimization.

- Ability to formulate and articulate viewpoints (written and verbal) in a clear, persuasive, and succinct manner.

- Ability to handle multiple concurrent efforts and provide high-quality deliverables accurately.

- Ability to work well in a fast-paced, team-oriented, collaborative environment that emphasizes attention to detail, meeting deadlines, and working together to achieve company-wide objectives.

- Strong interpersonal, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

What Would Be Nice

- Programming skills required: Python is a must; R, SQL, etc. are a plus.

- Working experience with stochastic models, mean reversion, and jump diffusion preferred.

- Exposure to ETRM systems, MtM, and VaR model validation/governance practices is a plus.

- Master’s or PhD is preferred.

No visa sponsorship or any kind of sponsorship for employment authorization is available for this role, now or in the future.

This is an exciting role in an innovative, high-growth defense technology company. The ideal candidate for the position is someone who has experience with designing, deploying and supporting the systems that connect the shop floor to our business. You'll support our Manufacturing Execution System and the surrounding floor-level technology, including data collection, traceability, work instructions, equipment integration, and production reporting. You'll work directly with operators, process engineers, quality, and IT to make sure production runs on accurate, real-time data. This role reports into the manufacturing organization.

- Lead or support MES rollouts, upgrades, and new line or site deployments, from requirements through validation and go-live

- Configure, maintain, and enhance the MES platform, including work orders, routings, BOMs, recipes, and electronic batch/device history records

- Build dashboards and reports for operations KPIs

- Support the Industry 4.0/smart factory roadmap, including IIOT pilots.

- Bachelor's degree in Industrial, Manufacturing, Electrical, Computer, or Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience)

- Working knowledge of manufacturing processes, shop floor workflows, and traceability concepts

- Experience with SQL and relational databases (SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL)

- Strong troubleshooting skills and comfort working in a live production environment

title: PMO & Portfolio Analyst
description:
Rithum™ is the world’s most trusted commerce network, accelerating how brands, suppliers, and retailers work together to deliver seamless e-commerce experiences. We provide an unmatched platform for brands and retailers, enabling them to accelerate growth, optimize operations across channels, scale product offerings and enhance margins.

Today, more than 40,000 companies trust Rithum to grow their business across hundreds of channels, representing over $50 billion in annual GMV. Using our commerce, marketing, and delivery solutions, our customers create optimized consumer shopping journeys from beginning to end.

Overview

As the PMO & Portfolio Analyst, you are at the operational core of the Brands Services program management office. You administer initiative intake, maintain the portfolio system of record, and produce the reporting and analysis that Brands Services leadership uses to make prioritization and resourcing decisions. You track dependencies, surface risks before they reach a milestone, and prepare the materials that make governance forums decision-ready. In this role, you are the person who knows the true status of every active initiative in the portfolio and can explain what it means.

At Rithum, all team members are expected to leverage AI to work smarter, accelerate decision-making, automate repeatable work, and improve outcomes. You are encouraged to continuously identify opportunities to apply AI, data, and scalable processes to enhance productivity, drive innovation, and deliver greater value for our clients, partners, and teams while maintaining appropriate judgment, quality, security, and compliance.

Responsibilities

Intake Administration & Triage Support

- Administer intake for Brands Services initiative requests: log, classify, route, and track status against turnaround targets

- Prepare triage packets and maintain decision logs so prioritization rationale stays traceable

Portfolio Reporting & Executive-Ready Analysis

- Build and maintain the portfolio reporting layer (status, milestones, health) sourced from existing systems, and keep improving it by automating manual steps

- Produce executive-ready analysis and KPI reporting that leads with the decision needed and the driver behind any variance

Initiative Tracking, Dependencies & Risk

- Maintain the initiative inventory of record (owners, success criteria, milestones, definition of done)

- Maintain the dependency register and risk/issue log, escalating against defined thresholds before milestones are at risk

Governance Preparation & Operating Cadence

- Run the operating cadence: prepare agendas, pre-reads, and status packets for governance forums, and capture/follow up on decisions and action items

- Maintain PMO templates and standards, and partner with initiative owners to keep portfolio data current and accurate

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications

- 2+ years of experience in program or project coordination, PMO operations, business operations, or an analyst role supporting initiative or portfolio reporting

- Demonstrated experience building and maintaining status or performance reporting for leadership

- Hands-on experience with a project or work management tool (Jira, Asana, Monday.com, Smartsheet, or similar), including building views, dashboards, and reports

- Advanced proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets, including pivot tables, lookups, and multi-source data consolidation, applied to portfolio or KPI analysis

- Experience tracking risks, issues, and dependencies across multiple concurrent initiatives

- Experience preparing meeting materials, pre-reads, or decision documents for senior stakeholders

- Experience using AI tools (ChatGPT, Copilot, Claude, etc.) to accelerate and elevate your outcomes; including but not limited to communication drafting, data analysis, prompt engineering, and/or documentation

Preferred Qualifications

- 3+ years of experience in PMO operations, program management, or business operations

- Bachelor's degree in the applicable discipline or related field preferred

- Experience in a SaaS, technology, or e-commerce organization

- Experience with business intelligence or visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau, Looker) or workflow automation tools (Power Automate, Zapier, or similar)

- Experience supporting an annual or quarterly planning cycle end to end

- Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to compress detail into a clear executive summary

- Comfort with ambiguity and a bias toward structuring work that is not yet defined

Travel Required

Up to 10%

Other Duties

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

What it’s like to work at Rithum

When you join Rithum, you can expect to work with smart risk-takers, courageous collaborators, and curious minds.

As part of the Rithum team, you are valued, supported, and included. Guided by a transparent culture and accessible, approachable leadership, we offer career opportunities aligned to your ambitions and talents. To ensure work and life balance works for you, we also offer an array of resources to support you and your families, including comprehensive benefits and wellness plans.

At Rithum you will:

- Connect with passionate professionals who will help support your goals.

- Participate in an inclusive, welcoming work atmosphere.

- Achieve work-life balance through remote-first working conditions, generous time off, and wellness days.

We believe in transparency and fairness in our compensation practices.

Final compensation may vary depending on geographic location, skills, and relevant experience.In addition to base pay, we offer a discretionary bonus for non-sales roles, a comprehensive benefits package, and, where applicable, sales incentives.

For this position, the expected discretionary bonus is 10% of the annual base salary.

Benefits

title: Senior Manager, Growth Algorithms
description:
About Stitch Fix, Inc.

Stitch Fix (NASDAQ: SFIX) Stitch Fix is redefining retail by combining human creativity with advanced data science and Generative AI. As we build the future of personalized shopping, we’re equally committed to building yours. We believe in investing in our team as much as our technology. Join us to be a trendsetter in the industry and help us redefine what’s possible for our clients, while we help you reach your full potential.

About the Role

At Stitch Fix, we are at the forefront of innovation, creating cutting-edge solutions that blend fashion, technology, and data science. Our data science team combines machine learning with expert human judgment to generate innovative recommendations and insights that transform the way our clients discover what they love. We believe in a curiosity-driven data science culture where members are empowered to deliver impact through end-to-end model development. The diversity of the problems we work on and the data-rich environment of our business make it possible and essential to bring the tools of multiple disciplines to bear on our hardest problems.

We are looking for an experienced team manager for Growth Algorithms to lead a talented group of data scientists responsible for optimizing client acquisition, retention, and reactivation. The team works across the client lifecycle—from paid media and onboarding to site experiences, CRM, incentives, and reactivation—using experimentation, predictive modeling, and personalized recommendations to help clients discover value and build lasting relationships with Stitch Fix.

This is a highly cross-functional leadership role. This leader will bring a compelling data science vision that gives the team focus and inspires partners, while building trusted relationships across Product, Marketing, Engineering, Finance, Design, Enterprise Analytics, and other Algorithms teams. This leader will emphasize technical excellence while influencing business strategy, improving decision quality, challenging historical constraints, and concentrating the team’s capacity on work with the highest client and business value.

What You'll Do

- Set and communicate a clear data science vision for Growth Algorithms, turning acquisition, activation, retention, and reactivation goals into a focused portfolio.

- Act as a trusted thought partner across Product, Marketing, Engineering, Finance, Design, and Enterprise Analytics; define clear ownership and shared best practices for experimentation, product analytics, AI/ML measurement, and decision support.

- Raise the bar for experimental design and interpretation, ensuring plans and outcomes reflect both statistical evidence and business context; turn uncertainty and tradeoffs into clear recommendations.

- Guide strategy for Next Best Action, lifecycle personalization, predictive value, CRM and paid media, onboarding funnel, and incentives.

- Challenge historical constraints and reframe persistent problems, establishing new technical, analytical, product, or operating approaches when established paths fall short.

- Make hard portfolio choices with rigor and care: consolidate overlapping capabilities, retire low-value work, reduce legacy complexity, and focus capacity on the highest-impact opportunities.

- Lead a team of full-stack data scientists who own work from opportunity sizing and experiment or model design through production deployment, measurement, monitoring, on-call, and incident response; partner with Engineering on reliable systems and choose the simplest effective approach.

- Build an inclusive, high-performing team grounded in ownership, candid feedback, curiosity, kindness, and continuous learning.

About You

This is what you’ll need to succeed in this role from day 1.

- Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field such as Computer Science, Statistics, Economics, Physics, Mathematics, Operations Research, or a related field required; master’s degree or PhD preferred.

- 5+ years of experience applying machine learning, experimentation, and causal inference to business problems, ideally across growth, lifecycle engagement, marketing, personalization, e-commerce, or retail.

- 2+ years of experience as a technical team lead or direct people manager, with a track record of developing strong talent and delivering meaningful outcomes through others.

- Deep practical expertise in experiment design and interpretation, including metric design, statistical power, sources of bias, and decision-making under uncertainty.

- Strong cross-functional leadership skills, including experience defining analytics ownership, decision rights, and best practices across Data Science, Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Analytics teams.

- A track record of creating a compelling data science strategy, translating it into a focused portfolio, and helping a team understand how its work connects to client and business outcomes.

- Demonstrated willingness to challenge assumptions, simplify complex systems or processes, and stop or consolidate lower-value work while leading change with transparency and empathy.

- Technical fluency to guide full-stack data science across analysis, experimentation, machine learning, system design, and production-quality Python code—and to raise quality through review, questions, and coaching.

- Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain evidence, uncertainty, tradeoffs, and recommendations to executives, business partners, and technical audiences.

- Sound judgment about where traditional machine learning, generative AI, AI-assisted development, and ad hoc analytical approaches create optimal value.

You’ll love working at Stitch Fix because you will…

- Fuse human creativity and styling expertise to redefine personalized retail.

- Set a high bar for our craft and drive measurable impact across fashion, tech, and data science.

- Actively leverage AI and modern tech to evolve how work gets done.

- Lead with innovation, think boldly, and aren't afraid to challenge conventional retail norms.

- Win together in a collaborative, low-ego environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated.

- Be client obsessed by putting our customers at the heart of every decision to deliver unmatched personalization and trust.

- Support our team with competitive compensation packages, comprehensive benefits, and meaningful career growth.

title: Digital Scientist
description:
A collective energy and ambition. A place where you can make a real difference.

We’re a company that genuinely cares about our people, our products, our consumers and the environment.

Our unique, informal culture champions courage, determination and collaboration. Knowing we have an open and supportive team means each of us has the freedom to take responsibility and ownership. We have a shared passion to work hard, innovate and push boundaries.

United by the belief that when we strive for growth, anything is possible. While we might not be the largest company in our industry, we believe we can have the biggest impact because: Together We Have the Power to Win.

Digital Scientist

Job Summary / About the Role

Church & Dwight is seeking a Digital Scientist. This position will be located onsite at our Princeton, New Jersey location.

Work Model: This is an onsite role based at Church & Dwight’s Princeton, New Jersey location. Occasional work in laboratory environments may be required. Minimal travel is expected (less than 10%).

The Digital Scientist will design, build, and scale practical digital tools and solutions that accelerate consumer research, laboratory operations, and artificial intelligence-enabled innovation within the Consumer Experience & Design Capabilities Group in Research & Development. This role will improve data access and decision-making, support responsible artificial intelligence governance and solution delivery, and develop digital methods for product screening and performance evaluation. The ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in computer science, data science, statistics, analytics, and digital transformation, with a proven ability to translate business needs and emerging technologies into actionable insights, scalable workflows, and measurable impact. Working with limited guidance, this role will manage routine work, contribute to moderately complex projects, and collaborate across consumer science, laboratory teams, Information Technology, and other functions.

Role Accountabilities and Responsibilities

- Digital Analytics: Lead moderately complex projects that improve how consumer research, laboratory, and project data are captured, connected, visualized, and used for decision-making across Research & Development.
- Data Visualization: Design, build, and maintain dashboards, reports, and visual analytics tools using platforms such as Power BI to monitor research outcomes, laboratory workflows, project performance, and capability metrics.
- Data Integration and Quality: Develop and improve data pipelines, integrations, templates, and structured data models that increase data quality, consistency, traceability, and artificial intelligence readiness across Laboratory Information Management Systems, SharePoint, digital bundle books, and related platforms.
- Model Development: Apply data science, statistics, and digital technologies to build or support predictive, classification, trend-detection, and automated analysis models for consumer insights, product screening, and performance evaluation.
- Insights and Recommendations: Translate analytical outputs into clear, actionable recommendations for scientists, project teams, and functional leaders, escalating complex or ambiguous issues when appropriate.
- Artificial Intelligence and Automation: Build, configure, and deploy artificial intelligence-enabled and workflow automation solutions, including Copilot agents, Power Automate flows, Power Apps, and low-code or no-code tools.
- Governance and Stewardship: Maintain intake workflows, evaluation criteria, responsible-use documentation, solution inventories, and adoption materials aligned with organizational standards.
- Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner with consumer scientists, laboratory teams, Information Technology, and other cross-functional stakeholders to identify digital use cases, define requirements, troubleshoot issues, and deliver practical solutions.
- Laboratory Method Development: Develop and digitize product screening and performance evaluation methods, including standardized protocols, data capture tools, analysis templates, and reporting outputs.
- Project Management: Contribute to project planning, requirements definition, testing, documentation, deployment, and adoption while independently managing assigned workstreams, priorities, risks, and stakeholder updates.
- Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to improve tools, workflows, and data practices and bring forward ideas that advance the digital transformation platform.

Education and Experience Requirements

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, Applied Mathematics, Engineering, or a related technical field.
- 2+ years of experience working with digital tools, analytics, automation, or artificial intelligence technologies.
- Proficiency in Python, R, or Structured Query Language for data analysis, scripting, and automation.
- Familiarity with data science libraries such as Pandas, NumPy, and scikit-learn and exposure to machine learning frameworks such as TensorFlow or PyTorch.
- Working experience with Power BI or Tableau, including creating dashboards, reports, and data models.
- Familiarity with Microsoft 365, including Excel, SharePoint, Power Platform, and Copilot.
- Familiarity with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services, or Google Cloud Platform.
- Experience with version control tools such as Git or GitHub.
- Experience with low-code or no-code platforms, including Power Apps, Power Automate, or Copilot Studio, and artificial intelligence agent development concepts.
- Basic understanding of data architecture, including data lakes, application programming interfaces, structured and unstructured data, and metadata management.
- Demonstrated ability to solve routine to moderately complex problems, manage assigned workstreams with limited guidance, and communicate technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
- Strong collaboration, documentation, prioritization, and continuous improvement skills.
- Commitment to data quality, traceability, responsible use, and compliance with internal standards.

Preferred Qualifications

- Master’s degree in a related technical field.
- Familiarity with statistical methods used in consumer research, including t-tests, analysis of variance, and regression.
- Experience with experimental design and analysis, including A/B testing or Design of Experiments.
- Experience in consumer packaged goods, fast-moving consumer goods, or Research & Development environments.
- Experience building artificial intelligence agents, using generative artificial intelligence tools, or supporting artificial intelligence-enabled business workflows.

title: Scientist/Engineer, Manufacturing Technology
description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.

Join Bristol Myers Squibb’s Devens Manufacturing Science and Technology- Manufacturing Technology team as a Scientist supporting commercial biologics manufacturing. In this role, you will serve as a process technical expert for large-scale cell culture and single-use manufacturing operations, providing science- and data-driven support to sustain GMP compliance, resolve complex process issues, and ensure reliable supply of life-changing therapies to patients.

As a key member of the Manufacturing Technology- Process Technical Operations team, you will serve as a technical lead for commercial biologics manufacturing, leading and supporting deviation investigations, root cause analyses, CAPA development, process monitoring, continuous process verification, change controls, regulatory inspection readiness, and lifecycle management activities. You will apply process knowledge, manufacturing data, and scientific judgment to identify trends, resolve complex process challenges, improve process robustness, and support reliable GMP execution. In this role, you will collaborate closely with Manufacturing, Quality, MS&T, Validation, Analytical, Technical Product Teams, and site leadership to strengthen process performance, enable technology transfer, and advance continuous improvement across biopharmaceutical manufacturing. This opportunity is ideal for a technically strong, collaborative scientist who thrives in a fast-paced, data-driven environment and is motivated by solving complex problems that directly support BMS’s mission to deliver patient-focused therapies.

Major Duties and responsibilities:

- Provide technical expertise and floor support for commercial biologics manufacturing operations, including investigation and resolution of process deviations, troubleshooting of process upsets, assessment of process performance, and identification of opportunities to improve process robustness, reliability, and efficiency.

- Lead and support root cause investigations for process deviations, including development of scientifically sound impact assessments, risk-based conclusions, and effective CAPAs to prevent recurrence and support timely batch disposition.

- Serve as a process subject matter expert for internal audits, regulatory inspections, technical discussions, and health authority interactions, including preparation of inspection-ready technical rationale, supporting documentation, and responses.

- Provide on-call technical support for 24x7 manufacturing support for large-scale cell culture and single-use biologics manufacturing operations, as needed.

- Demonstrate strong knowledge of cGMP expectations, BMS corporate standards, site procedures, regulatory requirements, and quality systems, and incorporate these expectations into investigations, change controls, technical assessments, and project deliverables.

- Support process technology transfer, process validation, process performance qualification, post-approval changes, and preparation or review of CMC documentation for regulatory filings and health authority responses.

- Lead and manage cross-functional technical projects that support process robustness, yield improvement, cost of goods reduction, digital manufacturing, operational excellence, and manufacturing performance objectives.

- Evaluate process performance using manufacturing data, historical process knowledge, statistical tools, and cross-site or prior campaign comparisons to identify trends, assess process capability, and recommend process enhancements.

- Author, review, and approve technical documents including protocols, reports, SOPs, technical assessments, risk assessments, impact assessments, campaign summaries, and other GMP documentation supporting commercial biologics manufacturing.

- Author and Review change controls, technical assessments, and supporting documentation to ensure technical accuracy, process alignment, GMP compliance, and regulatory consistency.

- Collaborate effectively with Manufacturing, Quality Assurance, Validation, Analytical, MS&T, Technical Product Teams, Supply Chain, Engineering, and site leadership to resolve technical issues, align decisions, and drive timely execution of site priorities.

- Actively contribute to a culture of safety, quality, accountability, continuous improvement, and scientific excellence by identifying risks, escalating concerns appropriately, and driving practical, compliant solutions.

Knowledge & Skills

- Knowledge of process engineering and science generally attained through studies resulting in a B.S., in engineering (like Biochemistry, Chemical or Biotechnology), a related discipline, or its equivalent with 5-7 years relevant experience in biopharmaceutical industry or its equivalent. Graduate education through M.S. (2-4 years of experience) or Ph.D. is highly desired (1-2 years of experience).

- Strong understanding of commercial biologics drug substance manufacturing, including upstream and/or downstream unit operations, process control strategy, facility operations, and GMP manufacturing execution.

- Demonstrated knowledge of SOPs, cGMPs, quality systems, regulatory expectations, and the ability to work effectively within a highly regulated manufacturing environment.

- Strong experience leading or supporting process deviation investigations, root cause analysis, impact assessments, CAPA development, and risk-based technical decision-making.

- Demonstrated ability to evaluate process data, identify meaningful trends, apply statistical or data analysis tools, and translate data into technically sound recommendations.

- Experience supporting continuous process verification, annual product quality review, campaign summaries, process monitoring, process validation, and/or process performance qualification activities.

- Experience with process technology transfer, process validation, lifecycle management, post-approval change support, and regulatory filing or inspection readiness activities.

- Experience in the design, modification, optimization, and troubleshooting of biologics manufacturing processes, equipment, and/or unit operations.

- Proven ability to lead and influence cross-functional teams, manage multiple technical priorities, and deliver results within project timelines in a matrixed environment.

- Demonstrated project management capability, including the ability to define scope, coordinate activities, manage risks, communicate status, and escalate issues appropriately.

- Broad knowledge of biopharmaceutical facility design, manufacturing operations, GMP documentation practices, and regulatory submission or inspection support.

- Experience with manufacturing data systems, statistical analysis tools, process historian tools, electronic batch records, DeltaV, or recipe-based manufacturing execution is highly desired.

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to clearly present complex technical information to manufacturing teams, quality partners, site leadership, and regulatory or audit audiences.

- Strong interpersonal and facilitation skills with the ability to build alignment, influence across functions, and drive decisions while maintaining a patient-focused, quality-first mindset.

title: Sr. Manager, Revenue Operations
description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

JOB DESCRIPTION

Red Seat Ventures partners with the world's top creators across multiple genres to grow and monetize their content — through advertising, subscription, live events, and beyond. We take a multiplatform approach spanning podcasting, video, FAST, and more, backed by our own proprietary tech stack including Supercast (subscription) and Speakeasy (hosting, distribution, and monetization).

Named after Ted Williams' longest home run at Fenway Park, RSV was built with a simple mandate: swing for the fences. Today, we're the fastest-growing creator network, backed by Tubi Media Group and Fox Corporation.

Position Overview

The Sr. Manager, Revenue Operations bridges the gap between sales strategy, technology, and data analytics. You will eliminate friction in the sales cycle by optimizing our revenue, building robust forecasting models, and maximizing inventory yield. This role is highly cross-functional, requiring close collaboration with Sales Leadership, Finance, and Account Executives (AEs) to align sales performance with our overarching financial targets.

Key Responsibilities

Sales Technology & Infrastructure

- Optimize Systems & Maintain Data Integrity: Act as the system administrator to ensure clean data entry, accurate tracking, and seamless integration between platforms.
- Automate Workflows: Design and deploy automated processes to reduce administrative tasks for the sales team.
- Maintain and refine Account Executive (AE) coverage lists.

Forecasting & Pipeline Management

- Build Models: Develop data-driven revenue forecasting models to provide executive leadership with predictable, forward-looking insights.
- Sales Planning: Connect sales goals to pipeline, historical performance, product opportunity and forecast assumptions.
- Pipeline Management: Monitor sales pipeline health, conversion rates, and deal stage to anticipate shifts in ad spend and market demand.
- Guide Strategy: Turn pipeline data into actionable insights that help sales teams proactively address gaps in the revenue funnel.Investigate questions that are not readily answered by existing reports, distinguish signal from noise, and analyze performance by product, show, AE, account, advertiser, and campaign. Turn findings into decisions and follow-through.

Go-To-Market (GTM) Data & Analytics

- Unified Dashboards: Build holistic reporting structures tracking performance by product (Video, YouTube, Audio, Direct Network, Programmatic). Also provide AEs and Leadership with customized reporting, dashboard and account spend analysis.
- AE Specific Reporting: Create centralized dashboards for individual AEs to track weekly closed revenue and pipeline metrics, serving as the champion of the CRM.
- Deep-Dive Analytics: Conduct revenue analysis, track year-over-year (YOY) account growth/declines, identify non-returning quarterly revenue, etc.
- Business Planning: Formulate annual and year-end AE business plans using historical performance data to help FY planning in top down and bottoms up formats.
- Build the capability to scale: Partner across departments to ensure processes, reporting, and technology support commercial decision-making. Help automate recurring analysis and establish repeatable practices as Red Seat Ventures grows.
- Identify growth opportunities: Use client, advertiser, market, product, and pipeline data to identify untapped accounts, categories, agencies, products, and distribution opportunities. Develop options for where Sales could focus and how existing relationships could grow.

Qualifications

Minimum Requirements

- Experience: 5-7+ years in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or Commercial Finance, ideally within media, digital advertising, or SaaS.
- Analytical Skills: Mastery of Excel/Google Sheets and data visualization tools to synthesize messy data sets into clean, executive-ready charts.
- Agility: Can answer ambiguous business questions and work with senior leadership and cross-functional teams to turn analysis into action.

Preferred Skills

- Industry Context: Deep understanding of the advertising sales industry and accounts lists; including the advertising ecosystem, specifically Podcasting, YouTube and Social.
- Commercial Decision Influence: Experience with using data to influence sales planning, account prioritization, pricing, packaging, ratecards, yield, and revenue planning.
- Communication: Ability to explain complex data trends to non-technical sales reps and executives alike.
- CRM Expertise: Advanced, hands-on administration experience with Salesforce (building dashboards, custom objects, and reports).

Senior developer within Treasury to support data, systems and forecasting needs of Treasury’s credit, interest rate risk, liquidity risk, CCAR (Comprehensive Capital Analysis and Review)/stress testing and economic capital practices. Serves as Bank-wide or industry expert in key area(s) of quantitative risk management. Provides mentoring, training, and guidance to less experienced analysts and may lead/manage teams on a project basis, providing performance feedback to management as appropriate.

Primary Responsibilities:

- Lead research and development for origination, credit, financial, demographic, behavioral, market and economic data pertinent to the Bank’s customers, portfolios and products. Interpret results, develop recommendations, and present findings to senior management.

- Support the end-to-end model development and implementation process for behavioral models supporting the firm’s credit risk management, interest rate risk, liquidity risk, stress testing and economic capital practices. Facilitate the model development effective challenge process with the Model Development Working and Model Development Oversight Groups.
- Work with a wide range of internal customers, including executive management, to explain the benefits, limitations, assumptions and requirements for proposed models, scorecards, and forecasts.
- Work closely with internal and external business partners to develop and implement strategies for optimal pricing, underwriting or funding strategy with the end goal of maximizing firm profitability.
- Develop, maintain, and manage satisfactory model documentation, including process narratives and performance monitoring guidelines to serve as reference source.
- Lead financial analysis and data support to other groups/departments across the Bank as required, serving as Bank-wide expert in area(s) of quantitative risk management. Lead engagements with colleagues in Model Risk Management for model validation exercises.
- Provide guidance and direction to less experienced personnel regarding all aspects of data and financial analysis and the development and management of predictive statistical models.
- Understand and adhere to the Company’s risk and regulatory standards, policies and controls in accordance with the Company’s Risk Appetite. Identify risk-related issues needing escalation to management.
- Maintain M&T internal control standards, including timely implementation of internal and external audit points together with any issues raised by external regulators as applicable.
- Complete other related duties as assigned.

Scope of Responsibilities:

The position serves as a quantitative expert in use of statistical programming languages to analyze Bank datasets and development, implementation and maintenance of credit risk models. It is important for the position to communicate with clear narratives, compelling data visualization and technical precision, both in-person and in writing, to enable audiences to understand analysis and forecasts. The position partners and collaborates with colleagues in related functions, including Credit Risk Management, Commercial and Consumer Business Units, Model Risk Management and review functions (Credit Review, Audit, etc.) to implement and understand models for Bank use. The position often leads team-based projects related to model development or implementation. This role is highly technical in nature and requires demonstrated attention to detail, execution and follow-up on multiple initiatives within Finance and across the Bank. The ability to identify, analyze, rationalize and communicate complex business, data and statistical problems and recommend corresponding solutions while directing the work of others on the team is a key factor of success in this role. The position may supervise the work of interns and/or lead teams on a project basis, providing performance feedback to management as appropriate. The position also provides guidance and direction to less experienced personnel.

- Bachelor’s degree and a minimum of 6 years’ proven quantitative behavioral modeling experience, or in lieu of a degree, a combined minimum of 10 years’ higher education and/or work experience, including a minimum of 6 years’ proven quantitative behavioral modeling experience
- Minimum of 6 years’ on-the-job experience with pertinent statistical software packages (SAS, Python, Stata, R)
- Minimum of 6 years’ on-the-job experience with data management environment, such as SQL Server Management Studio
- Minimum of 6 years’ on-the-job experience analyzing large data sets and explaining results of analysis through concise written and verbal communication as well as charts/graphs
- Credit modeling experience, including commercial credit score card development

- Masters’ of Science or Doctorate degree in statistics, economics, finance or related field in the quantitative social, physical or engineering sciences, with proven coursework proficiency in statistics, econometrics, economics, computer science, finance or risk management
- Minimum of 8 years’ statistical analysis programming experience
- Strong Python skills
- Financial Risk Manager (FRM) or Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA) designation
- Fluency and high proficiency in econometric/statistical techniques, especially time-series analysis, panel data methods and logistic regression
- Experience in balance sheet management and mathematical modeling of financial instruments offered by banks
- Knowledge and familiarity with key aspects of model risk management and model validation, including SR-11-7 guidance on model risk management
- Proven track record for being able to work autonomously and within a team environment
- Proven leadership skills
- Strong desire to learn and contribute to a group
- Previous experience leading and directing the work of less experienced personnel

title: Senior Associate, Risk and Structuring Analytics
description:
What The Role Is

Clearway Energy seeks a Senior Associate of Risk and Structuring Analytics to develop top-notch quantitative models that drive BESS valuation, structured products pricing, gas generation optimization, and power market analysis, while also quantifying and monitoring the risk exposures those positions create. In this role, you will build and enhance Clearway’s internal quantitative modeling platform (CWENQuant), develop advanced BESS dispatch optimization and price forecasting models, and provide independent risk analytics — mark-to-market, value-at-risk, credit, and scenario/stress analysis — that directly inform commercial decisions across trading, origination, development, and asset management.

What You'll Be Doing

Quantitative/Economic Modeling

- Develop and deploy to production complex optimization models and quantitative analysis for BESS dispatch optimization, renewables, gas generation, and data center infrastructure projects across the US.

- Develop Stochastic or Machine Learning / Deep Learning models to forecast DA, Ancillary, and RT prices based on fundamental variables such as load, gas prices, and wind + solar generation to inform trading.

- Develop and maintain gas dispatch, HRCO, toll, and other structured pricing models; perform mark-to-market analysis; support due diligence, underwriting, and credit analytics.

- Refine vendor models or develop in-house models for capacity expansion with a view on market policy (RPS/GHG reduction), LCOEs, retirements, transmission, reliability, and demand growth.

- Benchmark models against actual operations and market outcomes to improve forecast accuracy and optimization.

- Build and enhance CWENQuant; develop data pipelines with internal and external resources; create automated workflows and market data dashboards using data science and optimization techniques.

- Design and maintain mark-to-market (MtM), Value-at-Risk (VaR), and Profit-at-Risk (PaR) frameworks across BESS, gas, and structured product positions, independent of the deal/trading desks that originate them.

- Run scenario, sensitivity, and stress-testing analyses (price shocks, volatility regimes, basis blowouts, extreme weather/renewable generation outcomes) to quantify tail risk in the portfolio.

- Quantify hedge effectiveness and basis risk for structured transactions, PPAs, and tolling/HRCO arrangements; recommend hedge adjustments.

What You'll Bring

- Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Finance, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, or a related field.

- 3+ years of quantitative or modeling experience within the energy sector, including trading firms, banks, utilities, IPPs, ISOs, or BESS companies.

- Working experience developing ML/DL models using scikit-learn, Keras, or TensorFlow.

- Experience with linear/Mixed Integer programming and associated tools like PuLP, Gurobi, CPLEX, etc.

- Strong quantitative background with deep hands-on experience coding in Python.

- Knowledge of BESS (strongly preferred), renewable, and conventional (gas) assets, HRCO, and toll modeling.

- Strong understanding of power market economics, wholesale market structure, and asset operations in ISO (CAISO, ERCOT, etc.) markets.

- Proven ability to build top-notch optimization models and stochastic or ML/DL forecasting frameworks such as price, load, or renewable generation forecasting.

- Understanding of option pricing, volatility, game theory, opportunity cost, and optimization.

- Ability to formulate and articulate viewpoints (written and verbal) in a clear, persuasive, and succinct manner.

- Ability to handle multiple concurrent efforts and provide high-quality deliverables accurately.

- Ability to work well in a fast-paced, team-oriented, collaborative environment that emphasizes attention to detail, meeting deadlines, and working together to achieve company-wide objectives.

- Strong interpersonal, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

What Would Be Nice

- Programming skills required: Python is a must; R, SQL, etc. are a plus.

- Working experience with stochastic models, mean reversion, and jump diffusion preferred.

- Exposure to ETRM systems, MtM, and VaR model validation/governance practices is a plus.

- Master’s or PhD is preferred.

title: Logistics Replenishment Planning Manager
description:
Job Description

Position Summary

The Senior Analyst, Replenishment Logistics supports end-to-end basing logistics planning and execution by coordinating schedules, daily operations, and recovery plans across replenishment, warehousing, fulfillment, damage prevention, and customer management. This role translates planning signals into actionable operating plans, monitors execution to service and cost targets, identifies risks and constraints, and drives cross-functional actions to stabilize performance and drive predictability. serves as a subject matter expert for ocean network operations, leading complex analyses, driving strategic improvement initiatives, identifying operational risks and opportunities, and recommending solutions that enhance cost, service, and network performance. This role partners closely with Brewery and Winery Operations, Supply Chain Planning, Fulfillment, Distributor Operations, Customer Management, and domestic and international logistics partners to ensure reliable product flow and operational excellence across the global supply chain

Specialty Focus: This role is responsible for coordinating, communicating, executing transportation plans and supporting operations execution, and for tracking carrier and vendor performance metrics related to cost, transit time, velocity, and working capital management. The analyst services internal and external stakeholders by preparing performance insights, facilitating decision-making, and driving follow-up actions through S&OP, S&OE, Brewery & Winery Replenishment, and Distributor Operations Management.

Core Responsibilities: Operations Analyst (≈80%)

Execution & Operating Routines

- Coordinates basing logistics plans and operating schedules (daily/weekly/monthly) across replenishment, warehouse, and fulfillment to meet service, cost, and inventory targets, including support for appointment scheduling and shipment execution alignment
- Monitors execution versus plan; identifies constraints and execution gaps (e.g. MSO to target, appointment availability, late pickups, capacity, labor, inventory availability, carrier coverage) and drives same-day/week recovery actions with functional owners.
- Prepares agendas, pre-reads, and action logs for S&OE/weekly execution reviews, Distributor Operations touchpoints, and site/warehouse operating reviews, ensuring alignment on shipment execution, service risks, and recovery actions, and documents decisions and follow-ups.
- Leads issue triage by gathering facts, quantifying customer/service impact, and routing/owning actions across replenishment, fulfillment, damage prevention, transportation, and customer management teams through to closure.

Reporting & Data Support

- Builds and maintains routine performance reporting (service, fill rate, on-time delivery, inventory health, damages, claims, transportation cost, transit time, velocity, and working capital) using available system outputs, platforms, and business intelligence tools to deliver accurate, timely, and standardized insights.
- Validates data completeness and investigates anomalies; partners with WMS/TMS/ERP process owners, carriers, and vendors to correct data and address root causes impacting metrics and execution performance.
- Compiles weekly and monthly KPI packs and scorecards for S&OP, S&OE, Distributor Operations, and Logistics Council forums; ensures consistent metric definitions, commentary, and version control, and highlights key risks, gaps, and performance trends.

Documentation & Training Support

- Maintains operations playbooks and documentation (standard work, escalation paths, recovery plans, capacity assumptions, carrier routing guides, and hand-offs) by incorporating approved changes and confirming owners and effective dates.
- Supports deployment of new routines and changes by preparing materials, coordinating communications, and tracking completion/adoption across internal teams and external partners as needed.
- Ensures operating standards, scheduling expectations, and escalation processes are communicated consistently across replenishment, warehousing, fulfillment, transportation partners, and customer-facing teams.
- Contributes to, creates and maintains standard operating procedures, process/decision flow maps, and best practice documentation.

Cross-Functional Coordination

- Coordinates across Logistics, Customer Management, Supply Chain Planning, Warehouse Operations, Procurement, Finance, and IT—plus carriers and 3PLs—to align capacity, resolve execution issues, and close action items.
- Drafts clear updates on transportation plans, exceptions, and recovery actions; facilitates timely escalation and decision-making to protect customer commitments and cost targets.
- Ability to proactively communicate and matrix influence across internal and external stakeholders

Role-Specific Responsibilities: (≈20%)

- Leads ocean network planning and execution in alignment with basing plans, inventory requirements, warehouse capacity, and customer service expectations; identifies risks, constraints, and optimization opportunities.
- Owns ocean network performance management, analyzing transportation cost, transit time reliability, container velocity, dwell time, service performance, claims/damages, and working capital drivers; develops recommendations and drives corrective actions.
- Leads management of ocean network exceptions, including vessel delays, port congestion, customs holds, equipment shortages, drayage constraints, shortages, and damages; coordinates recovery efforts to minimize service and financial impacts.
- Drives continuous improvement initiatives by leveraging operational and financial data to improve service, inventory flow, network reliability, and total transportation cost; leads root cause analysis and corrective actions.
- Develops business insights, recommendations, and executive-ready materials for S&OP, S&OE, Distributor Operations, Logistics Council, and leadership reviews; translates network performance and risks into actionable decisions.
- Leads engagement with ocean network partners through performance reviews, capacity planning discussions, and corrective action follow-ups; drives accountability for service, cost, and operational performance.
- Supports transportation budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning by identifying cost trends, risks, savings opportunities, and network optimization initiatives.
- Leads cross-functional projects focused on ocean network optimization, cost reduction, service improvement, and process standardization; drives alignment and delivers measurable results.

Supports ocean network risk management and contingency planning by evaluating routing alternatives, capacity strategies, and response plans for weather, port congestion, labor disruptions, and other supply chain risks.

Minimum Qualifications (Core)

- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
- Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, maintain action logs, and drive closure across cross-functional teams in a fast-paced operating environment.
- Proficient in data analysis and interpretation; comfortable working with outputs from ERP/WMS/TMS and shipment visibility tools to build KPI reporting and insights.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to translate data into clear narratives, facilitate operating routines, and escalate risks with recommended actions.
- Bilingual proficiency in English and Spanish is required, including the ability to communicate effectively both verbally and written

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience coordinating transportation planning/execution and/or carrier performance management (scorecards, QBR support, corrective actions).
- Working knowledge of end-to-end supply chain processes (replenishment planning, warehousing, fulfillment, transportation, claims/damages, Distributor/Customs) and common system transactions.
- Exposure to S&OP/S&OE operating models and/or distributor operations forums; experience with BI tools (e.g., Power BI/Tableau) and structured problem-solving is a plus.

Physical Requirements / Work Environment

- Ability to sit/stand for extended periods and work on a computer; occasional lifting may be required.
- Field/onsite visits, warehouse/transportation facility walk-throughs, or audit support may be required; travel as needed.
