title: Product Owner - NBS
description:
Nelnet Business Services (NBS), a division of Nelnet, Inc., provides payment technology and education services to more than 1,200 higher education institutions, nearly 12,000 K-12 schools, and millions of individual students, families, and supporters across the globe. Our culture of service enables us to form long-lasting and trusted partnerships, while our focus on creativity and innovative solutions empowers our customer communities to thrive.

Job Profile Summary

The Product Owner coordinates product development, release planning, and manages the overall successful delivery of new and existing products. This position supports the reporting and analytics products within a student information system — including embedded Power BI reports, district and school dashboards, and self-service report-building tools used by K-12 administrators and educators. The Product Owner works closely with school and district users to understand the questions they need answered and translates those needs into data-driven product solutions.

Job Responsibilities

1. Works very closely with agile development teams to create use cases, requirements, and estimates in support of company objectives.

2. Serves as a liaison between school and district users (administrators, data coordinators, and educators) and the development team — understanding the decisions they need to make and translating reporting and analytics needs into actionable requirements and user stories.

3. Defines and maintains clear metric and data definitions (e.g., attendance rates, grade distributions, enrollment and demographic measures) so that reports are consistent, accurate, and trusted across products.

4. Collaborates with development and data teams on the underlying data model — including source data views, relationships, calculations, and data quality — to ensure reports reflect the student information system accurately.

5. Manages the lifecycle of the standard report and dashboard catalog, including prioritizing new reports, coordinating releases and updates to customers, and retiring outdated content.

6. Shapes the self-service reporting experience, including how users build, save, share, and find reports, and how roles and permissions control access to student data.

7. Ensures reporting solutions respect student data privacy requirements (e.g., FERPA) and appropriate data access boundaries between districts, schools, and user roles.

8. Uses product usage analytics (report views, favorites, active users) to understand adoption, measure value, and inform prioritization.

9. Spends a significant amount of time validating report mockups, prototypes, and early-stage dashboards with clients.

10. Works with sales, technical sales, marketing and product manager to provide content for sales, user training and documentation tools.

11. Ensures client documentation is updated and effective including release notes, report definitions, and roadmaps.

12. Works with clients directly and manages a client feedback tool to ensure voice of the customer is heard and felt in each product.

Education

1. Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

Experience

1. 1+ years related experience or existing product knowledge.

2. Experience with business intelligence or reporting tools — Microsoft Power BI strongly preferred (building reports, understanding data models, basic DAX or Power Query).

3. Experience with K-12 education data or student information systems preferred.

4. Ability to read and write basic SQL queries, or comparable experience exploring and validating data, preferred.

Competencies — Skills/Knowledge/Abilities

1. Ability to prioritize and manage multiple concurrent projects.

2. Flexibility to adapt quickly to new requirements, situations, programs, and services.

3. Understanding of data visualization best practices and the ability to design reports that clearly answer a user's question.

4. Comfort working with data — understanding data elements, relationships, calculations, and quality/validation concepts — without needing to be a developer.

5. Ability to turn loosely defined questions ("How are my students doing?") into specific, measurable requirements.

6. Ability to communicate effectively with both technical audiences (developers, data engineers) and non-technical audiences (school and district users).

7. Strong attention to detail, particularly in validating that numbers are accurate and consistent.

8. Analytical thinking: Forms a hypothesis, tests it against the data, and knows when the data supports a conclusion and when it doesn't.

9. Data storytelling: Designs reports and insights that answer the user's question and point to an action, not just display numbers.

10. Strong customer focus.

11. Ability to be a team player.

12. Good time management and organizational skills.

13. Strong written and oral communication skills.

14. Strong problem-solving skills.

15. Demonstrated respect, collaboration, and pride in ownership.

16. Ability to adapt to change.

17. Focus on delivering value.

title: Assistant Director, Enrollment Data Systems CRM
description:
Job Title:
Assistant Director, Enrollment Data Systems CRM

Job Summary:
The Assistant Director of Enrollment Data Systems (AD) serves as a subject matter expert in Strategic Enrollment Management (SEM) data systems, with a focus on quality assurance, system integrations, data integrity, and Slate administration. The AD supports the Undergraduate (UG), Graduate (GRAD), and Certificate (CERT) Slate environments and works collaboratively with the Enrollment Data Systems team and University stakeholders to monitor and maintain the systems and data processes supporting enrollment operations.

A primary focus of the position is shared monitoring and quality assurance across USF’s enrollment technology ecosystem, including data movement between Slate, Axiom Elite, and Ellucian Banner; established intra- and inter-system validation controls; major third-party and AI-assisted application integrations; and person and application-level fraud and anomaly detection. The AD investigates system and data exceptions/errors, supports established SQL, Tableau, and Slate-based monitoring processes, and recommends enhancements as business requirements, integrations, and emerging risks evolve.

The AD also provides functional and technical support for SEM operations and high-level support for USF’s decentralized Graduate Schools and Colleges and professional programs, while supporting SEM’s responsibility for shared integrations and enterprise enrollment processes. The position emphasizes collaboration, proactive monitoring, root-cause analysis, continuous improvement, and the development and sharing of innovative enrollment technology practices. The AD reports to the Senior Associate Director of Enrollment Data Systems, CRM.

Full Job Description:

Job Responsibilities

Slate Administration & Enrollment Systems Support

- Provide functional and technical Slate support for SEM departments, including Undergraduate Enrollment Operations, Undergraduate Admissions, and Undergraduate Enrollment Communications.

- Provide functional and technical Slate support for the decentralized Graduate Schools and Colleges (GRAD), including the Certificate (CERT) Slate instance supporting USF’s professional programs, with SEM maintaining responsibility and authority for integration-related enhancements, maintenance, configuration, and modifications affecting enterprise systems, data exchanges, and shared enrollment processes.

Data Quality Assurance - Slate, Axiom Elite, & Ellucian Banner

- Share responsibility for the daily validation and monitoring of Axiom integrations across the Undergraduate (UG), Graduate (GRAD), and Certificate (CERT) Slate instances, working collaboratively with other Enrollment Data Systems team members and appropriate stakeholders to monitor the successful movement of application, test score, school, decision, and other enrollment data between Slate, Axiom, and Ellucian Banner.

- Share responsibility for investigating and resolving Axiom and related integration errors/exceptions across the Undergraduate (UG), Graduate (GRAD), and Certificate (CERT) Slate instances, working collaboratively with other Enrollment Data Systems team members and appropriate stakeholders to trace records across Slate, Axiom, and Banner; identify points of failure; correct source data, mappings, or system logic when appropriate; and validate successful downstream processing.

- Share responsibility for monitoring established cross-system data integrity audits across the Undergraduate (UG), Graduate (GRAD), and Certificate (CERT) Slate instances, comparing live Slate data against live Ellucian Banner data using tools such as Tableau, SQL-based reporting, and other institutional data-validation tools.

- Share responsibility for monitoring and maintaining established Undergraduate (UG) equilibrium-method scholarship quality-assurance queries and controls, including intra-Slate validation of scholarship eligibility, calculations, and assigned awards, as well as inter-system validation between Slate and Banner to ensure scholarship data is accurately reflected across systems.

Person and Application Fraud Quality Assurance

- Co-monitor established system controls, metrics, and automated detection processes across the Undergraduate and Graduate Slate instances, in collaboration with the Enrollment Data Systems team, SEM stakeholders, and the decentralized Graduate Schools and Colleges. Monitoring includes person-level spam and anomalous activity, including SMS/text messaging patterns and usage, as well as application-level fraudulent, anomalous, and Ghost application activity.

- Monitor evolving spam and application fraud trends, patterns, and attack methods, and proactively recommend new or enhanced detection and prevention methodologies as behaviors change.

- Evaluate and recommend enhancements to queries, rules, scoring methodologies, reports, integrations, and automated controls to address emerging risks and strengthen data quality and system protections.

Integration Quality Assurance - Third-Party Systems

- Co-monitor established application-level auditing and reconciliation processes for major bilateral application integrations within the Undergraduate Slate instance, including AI-assisted application review integrations and other systems that transmit application information externally and return structured information to Slate.

Data Analysis, Continuous Improvement & Compliance

- Maintain and advance professional knowledge through active participation in Slate Summit and other relevant conferences, training opportunities, documentation, and professional communities, with an emphasis on contributing to USF’s strong tradition of presenting at Summit and sharing innovative practices with the broader Slate community.

- Use data and systems analysis to identify opportunities to improve, automate, and strengthen enrollment business processes, collaborating with appropriate stakeholders to develop and implement recommendations.

- Ensure the integrity and confidentiality of student academic and applicant records by complying with FERPA, University policies, and applicable data-governance requirements.

- Perform other related duties as assigned.

Minimum Requirements

- Bachelor’s degree required.

- Understanding of and commitment to the University of San Francisco’s Vision, Mission, and Values.
-

- Experience with and demonstrated ability to work effectively with a diverse student body, faculty, and staff.

- Strong equity lens, cultural humility, and demonstrated ability to work effectively in a diverse environment.

- 1–3 years of experience working in university enrollment management, enrollment technology, CRM administration, student information systems, or a related area.

- At least one year of administrative experience with Technolutions Slate CRM required.

- Demonstrated understanding of Slate Configurable Joins, queries, exports, filters, and data structures.

- Experience working with Slate functionality including queries, reports, application cycle preparation, Deliver, rules and populations, forms, Reader, Inbox, events, portals, and integrations.

- Demonstrated experience using SQL or SQL-based query tools for data validation, reconciliation, troubleshooting, and reporting.

- Working knowledge of Student Information Systems and the movement of data between CRM, middleware, SIS, and third-party platforms.

- Demonstrated ability to investigate complex data or integration issues by tracing records across multiple systems and identifying root causes.

- Experience with data-quality assurance, exception reporting, reconciliation, or other systematic approaches to validating data integrity.

- Data reporting and analysis experience required.

- Demonstrated experience configuring and editing Liquid Markup.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate business requirements into appropriate technical or process solutions.

- Strong interpersonal and communication skills, including the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear language for functional stakeholders.

- Demonstrated ability to independently manage recurring operational monitoring, investigate exceptions, prioritize issues, and follow problems through resolution.

- Strong desire and aptitude to continue developing technical and professional expertise within SEM.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience as a functional user of Ellucian Banner, including Banner Student.

title: Sr Analyst, Data Integrity, Enablement & Validation
description:
Champion trusted data that drives confident decisions

In this role, you help ensure that every business insight across Resmed is built on reliable, transparent, and well‑understood data. As part of the Data Insights team within our Commercial Insights and Data Science organization, you connect data sources, analytics teams, and business stakeholders to create a single version of truth. Your work supports smarter decisions that help us deliver innovative solutions to patients, providers, and partners.

You will bring clarity to complex data landscapes—supporting the development and adoption of standardized metrics, validating data quality, reconciling inconsistencies, and embedding repeatable integrity checks that enhance confidence in analytics and enterprise reporting. This is an opportunity to combine technical expertise with business understanding and communication skills to translate complex data issues into clear findings, recommendations, and solutions; hence enabling the entire organization to make decisions based on trusted information.

What You’ll Do

- Partner with business, analytics, product, and technical stakeholders to define data requirements, metric definitions, business rules, and use cases.
- Validate internal and external data sources for accuracy, consistency, completeness, and usability with minimal supervision.
- Investigate and reconcile discrepancies across multiple datasets and reporting environments, identify root causes and recommend remediation.
- Develop, maintain, and enhance repeatable validation processes, reconciliation methodologies, and quality controls for critical business data.
- Validate new datasets, metrics, dashboards, and analytical products prior to broader adoption, and collaborate with data engineering and analytics teams to address upstream data quality issues.
- Monitor key datasets and metrics for anomalies, gaps, unexpected changes, and emerging data quality concerns, and develop reporting tools that provide visibility into data integrity.
- Support the development and governance of standardized enterprise metrics, definitions, and business rules, while maintaining clear documentation of data sources, lineage, methodologies, assumptions, and limitations.

- Enable analysts and business partners to effectively access, understand, and use trusted data for analysis and insights-generation.
- Translate complex technical findings into clear, non-technical language for business stakeholders and leadership to support informed decision-making.

What You Bring

- Bachelor’s degree in information technology, data analytics, computer science, finance, statistics, business, or related field.
- 5+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, data quality, data governance, or related analytical discipline.
- Proficiency in SQL for investigating, identifying root causes of data discrepancies, validating, reconciling, and analyzing large and complex datasets across multiple systems.
